jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Accounting team at Relativity spans tax and compliance, financial operations, general ledger, and business data strategy. While each group brings unique insights, they are united by a shared goal of protecting the financial integrity of Relativity, while also enabling smarter, faster decisions to help the company scale. You’ll collaborate deeply with teams across the business, ask the right questions, and become a trusted partner, not just a processor. With a focus on enabling growth, you’ll bring both structure and creativity to a highly dynamic environment.

About the Role

• Serve as the senior accounting leader for the manufacturing site, owning the accuracy and integrity of site financial results and partnering closely with the Plant Manager and site leadership.

• Lead plant accounting and close activities across manufacturing costs, inventory, fixed assets, capital projects, reconciliations, accruals, and financial reporting.

• Own manufacturing and cost accounting, including standard costs, labor and overhead, work in process, inventory valuation, and analysis of production and manufacturing variances.

• Establish strong financial controls and disciplined processes across inventory, production reporting, purchasing, receiving, fixed assets, capital expenditures, and other plant operations.

• Partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, FP&A, and Corporate Accounting to translate manufacturing activity into accurate financial insights and improve business decisions.

• Build and strengthen the accounting infrastructure needed to support the transition from development and low-rate production to repeatable, rate-based manufacturing, while leading and developing the site accounting team.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field with 10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including significant experience in manufacturing.

• Proven experience in plant controllership, site accounting, or manufacturing accounting leadership within a complex, capital-intensive environment.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, inventory accounting, standard costing, manufacturing variances, fixed assets, and capital-project accounting.

• Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and plant leadership to understand operational drivers and solve complex financial issues.

• Experience building or strengthening accounting processes, internal controls, and financial reporting in a growing or evolving manufacturing environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate financial results at the operational level and maintain a regular, hands-on presence within manufacturing operations.

Nice to Have

• CPA, CMA, MBA, or other relevant advanced qualification.

• Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial equipment, heavy machinery, or another highly engineered manufacturing environment.

• Experience supporting a transition from development or low-rate production to repeatable manufacturing, including implementing or improving standard costing and manufacturing master data.

• Experience with complex manufacturing ERPs such as Infor LN, SAP, or Oracle, along with exposure to SOX, government contracting, project accounting, data analytics, or process automation.

jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Accounting team at Relativity spans tax and compliance, financial operations, general ledger, and business data strategy. While each group brings unique insights, they are united by a shared goal of protecting the financial integrity of Relativity, while also enabling smarter, faster decisions to help the company scale. You’ll collaborate deeply with teams across the business, ask the right questions, and become a trusted partner, not just a processor. With a focus on enabling growth, you’ll bring both structure and creativity to a highly dynamic environment.

About the Role

• Serve as the senior accounting leader for the manufacturing site, owning the accuracy and integrity of site financial results and partnering closely with the Plant Manager and site leadership.

• Lead plant accounting and close activities across manufacturing costs, inventory, fixed assets, capital projects, reconciliations, accruals, and financial reporting.

• Own manufacturing and cost accounting, including standard costs, labor and overhead, work in process, inventory valuation, and analysis of production and manufacturing variances.

• Establish strong financial controls and disciplined processes across inventory, production reporting, purchasing, receiving, fixed assets, capital expenditures, and other plant operations.

• Partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, FP&A, and Corporate Accounting to translate manufacturing activity into accurate financial insights and improve business decisions.

• Build and strengthen the accounting infrastructure needed to support the transition from development and low-rate production to repeatable, rate-based manufacturing, while leading and developing the site accounting team.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field with 10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including significant experience in manufacturing.

• Proven experience in plant controllership, site accounting, or manufacturing accounting leadership within a complex, capital-intensive environment.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, inventory accounting, standard costing, manufacturing variances, fixed assets, and capital-project accounting.

• Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and plant leadership to understand operational drivers and solve complex financial issues.

• Experience building or strengthening accounting processes, internal controls, and financial reporting in a growing or evolving manufacturing environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate financial results at the operational level and maintain a regular, hands-on presence within manufacturing operations.

Nice to Have

• CPA, CMA, MBA, or other relevant advanced qualification.

• Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial equipment, heavy machinery, or another highly engineered manufacturing environment.

• Experience supporting a transition from development or low-rate production to repeatable manufacturing, including implementing or improving standard costing and manufacturing master data.

• Experience with complex manufacturing ERPs such as Infor LN, SAP, or Oracle, along with exposure to SOX, government contracting, project accounting, data analytics, or process automation.

Successful candidates must clear a background check administered by the US government to obtain clearance for on-site work at our government partner location in Cape Canaveral, Florida.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

BAYADA Home Health Care at Bayhealth is currently seeking an experienced Speech Language Pathologist, SLP, for a full-time opportunity performing home health visits for our office located in Dover, DE.  This office services adult and geriatric patients in homes throughout Kent County area.

Prior home care experience as a Speech Language Pathologist, SLP is a plus, but not required.

As a home care Speech Language Pathologist, SLP, you will be an integral member of a multi-disciplinary health care team that provides rehabilitative care and skilled nursing to clients, affording them the opportunity to receive the medical care required to remain at home.

Speech Language Pathologist, SLP Responsibilities:

• Make home visits to clients in designated geographic territories.

• Educate and instruct patients, family members, or other patient representatives, in rehabilitative care and activities necessary to promote the client's health, safety, and independent living.

• Accurately document observations, interventions, and evaluations pertaining to patient care management and services provided, utilizing a state-of-the-art touch pad tablet.

Speech Language Pathologist, SLP Qualifications:

• A current license as a Speech Language Pathologist in DE.

• Possess a certificate of clinical competence in speech from the American Speech and Hearing Association, or;

• Have the equivalent educational requirements, as indicated by school transcript or diploma, and work experience necessary for such a certificate, and be awaiting the opportunity to take the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association examination for certification, or;

• Have completed the necessary work and education requirements, as indicated by school transcript or diploma, and be in the process of accumulating the necessary supervised work experience required for certification.

• Solid computer skills; prior experience with electronic medical records (EMR) preferred.

Alliance Corporation is a leading North American value-added distributor of products and solutions for Wireless Networking, in-building signal coverage and cellular infrastructure applications. We are a fast-paced, aggressive company in an exciting, high-growth market that has shown consistent year-over-year revenue expansion. By partnering with our vendors and clients, we position valued solutions for all of their wireless communications needs.

Alliance Corporation is seeking a Warehouse Associate to join our growing team.

Want to be part of building our wireless world? Technology like 5G and IoT – aids emergency responders, enables intelligent warehouses and factories, increases safety on college campuses, helps energy companies provide better service, improves safety and efficiency of various modes of transportation – to say nothing of enhancing consumer experiences including entertainment, shopping, and communications. In fact, wireless technology touches every aspect of our daily lives.

You will work across product, marketing, creative, engineering and agency teams to develop and execute memorable experiences that showcase emerging technologies, including AI, VR and wearable products.

The team supports major industry and cultural moments including CES, GDC, Coachella, the Super Bowl, NBA All Star events and other global experiences, along with Meta events such as Connect, product launches, press events, partner activations and policy events.

This is an opportunity for someone who knows how to take a complex product experience from concept through execution while balancing creative vision, technical requirements, logistics, budgets and multiple stakeholders.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of client facing experience in event management, experiential production or a creative agency environment

• Demonstrated experience producing large scale, complex events and experiences

• Strong program and project management capabilities with an operational mindset and exceptional organization

• Experience with VR, AI, emerging technology or technology driven product experiences

• Experience coordinating both in person and virtual events

• Strong cross functional collaboration and stakeholder management experience

This team is responsible for more than producing events. It owns the product experience within the event, including how products are integrated, demonstrated and experienced by attendees.

You will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of emerging technology while supporting experiences that span major company initiatives, global industry events and some of the most recognizable moments across technology, sports, entertainment and culture.

jobs.title: Director of Ticket Sales - Chesapeake Baysox
jobs.description:
Attain Sports brings a community-focused, values-driven, and player-centric approach to connect diverse groups and create impact through the power of sports. The company was formed in 2021 and presents an affordable, family-friendly sports and entertainment portfolio that brings a commitment to community engagement, customer service, innovation, and the professional growth and development of its family of athletes and employees.

Attain Sports owns and manages four baseball teams: the Baltimore Orioles Double-A affiliate Chesapeake Baysox, the Baltimore Orioles High-A affiliate Frederick Keys, the MLB Draft League Aberdeen IronBirds, and the Atlantic League Professional Baseball Club Spire City Ghost Hounds. Additionally, Attain Sports is an owner of the United Soccer League (USL) Championship Club Loudoun United FC.

The Chesapeake Baysox (Double-A Affiliate of the Baltimore Orioles) are seeking a motivated and experienced sales leader to serve as Director, Ticket Sales. This position is responsible for leading the Baysox ticket sales department and driving revenue across season tickets, group sales, hospitality, and other ticket products.

The Director, Ticket Sales will oversee the day-to-day performance of the ticket sales team, establish a consistent and accountable sales culture, develop sales representatives, and ensure the department is positioned to achieve its annual revenue goals.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can coach and develop sales representatives, establish clear expectations, monitor performance, identify new revenue opportunities, and work collaboratively across the organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Sales Leadership and Revenue Performance

• Lead the Chesapeake Baysox ticket sales department with responsibility for achieving annual ticket sales revenue goals.

• Develop and execute sales strategies across season tickets, group sales, hospitality, premium areas, and other ticket products.

• Establish individual and departmental sales goals that align with the organization's annual budget and revenue objectives.

• Monitor sales activity and revenue performance throughout the year and adjust strategies as necessary to remain on pace toward goals.

• Identify new opportunities to grow ticket revenue, attendance, and the Baysox customer base.

• Maintain an active presence in the sales process and assist representatives with larger or more complex opportunities when appropriate.

• Support the development and execution of renewal, retention, and new business campaigns.

• Work closely with leadership to evaluate pricing, inventory, ticket products, and sales opportunities.

Staff Management and Development

• Manage, coach, and develop the Baysox ticket sales staff.

• Establish clear expectations for sales activity, prospecting, follow-up, pipeline management, and revenue production.

• Conduct regular individual meetings with sales representatives to review performance, pipelines, opportunities, and professional development.

• Lead regular ticket sales meetings focused on performance, strategy, training, and accountability.

• Develop and implement an ongoing sales training program covering prospecting, cold calling, needs analysis, presentations, objection handling, closing, referrals, and account management.

• Provide consistent coaching and feedback to help sales representatives improve their skills and advance professionally.

• Assist with recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training new ticket sales employees.

• Create a positive, competitive, and accountable sales environment focused on continuous improvement and team success.

Sales Activity and Pipeline Management

• Establish and monitor minimum expectations for outbound calls, emails, appointments, meetings, and other sales activity.

• Ensure sales representatives maintain accurate and current pipelines and customer records.

• Review individual pipelines regularly to identify opportunities, challenges, and appropriate next steps.

• Develop prospecting strategies and lead-generation initiatives to create new business opportunities.

• Ensure consistent follow-up with prospects and customers throughout the sales process.

• Utilize ticketing and CRM systems to track activity, measure performance, and improve sales effectiveness.

Group Sales and Community Development

• Develop strategies to grow group ticket sales among businesses, schools, youth sports organizations, nonprofits, community organizations, churches, and other potential customers.

• Identify opportunities to develop new theme nights, group programs, and ticket initiatives that generate incremental revenue and attendance.

• Build relationships throughout Prince George's County and the surrounding region to expand the Baysox customer base.

• Work with the marketing and promotions teams to support ticket sales campaigns and lead-generation initiatives.

Reporting and Forecasting

• Maintain accurate sales forecasts and provide regular updates on departmental performance.

• Track revenue, activity, pipeline development, renewals, and other key performance indicators.

• Provide leadership with regular reporting on progress toward departmental and individual goals.

• Identify performance trends and develop action plans when the department or individual representatives are behind pace.

• Ensure accurate utilization of ticketing, CRM, and reporting systems throughout the department.

Cross-Department Collaboration

• Work closely with Marketing, Corporate Partnerships, Box Office, Operations, and other departments to support organizational goals.

• Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns designed to generate leads, increase attendance, and support ticket sales initiatives.

• Coordinate with the Box Office and Ticket Operations teams to ensure a positive purchasing and customer service experience.

• Represent the ticket sales department in organizational meetings and planning discussions.

• Support organizational initiatives, games, events, and other activities as needed.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in ticket sales, sports sales, hospitality sales, or a related revenue-generating position.

• Previous sales management or leadership experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and motivate sales professionals.

• Strong understanding of prospecting, pipeline management, relationship selling, and sales strategy.

• Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

• Ability to establish expectations and hold team members accountable while maintaining a positive and supportive work environment.

• Experience working with CRM, ticketing, and sales reporting systems preferred.

• Ability to analyze sales performance and use data to make informed decisions.

• Willingness and ability to work games, evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events as required.

Additional Information

Attain Sports values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

• Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs

• 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)

• Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting

• Flexible career paths – our career tracks provide advancement, mobility, and flexibility as you continue to grow with us

• A healthy environment where we value unique experiences, and care about everything that makes you, you.

Attain Sports is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The individual base salary for this position is unique to each candidate and will be commensurate with experience, education, and skills.

Interested in this position but the compensation isn’t quite right? Let us know your expectations, and we’ll see if we can make it happen based on your qualifications.

$50,000—$60,000 USD

jobs.title: Buyer/Planner
jobs.description:
The Buyer/Planner manages end-to-end material flow from raw material procurement through the final delivery of finished goods, utilizing Material Requirement Planning (MRP) to guarantee material availability while managing plant capacity through efficient production planning and scheduling.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

• Solicit bid proposals, review requisitions, prepare purchase orders, and maintain accurate purchasing records while ensuring compliance with import regulations and Pyrotek OFAC requirements.
• Research and evaluate potential and existing suppliers based on price, quality, capability, and technical specifications to drive cost improvements and obtain competitive freight quotes.
• Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure timely material flow, proactively expediting orders and shipments to mitigate production or delivery delays.
• Process Material Requirements Planning (MRP) reports to plan, schedule, and release work orders while aligning shop floor capacity, manufacturing lead times, and labor availability with customer deadlines.
• Perform frequent evaluations of stocking levels and quarterly reviews of safety stock parameters to optimize inventory turnover, minimize aged stock, and ensure inventory accuracy.
• Analyze production statuses and capacity utilization to identify bottlenecks, manage open work orders, and maintain alignment with original due dates.
• Monitor demand changes and immediately communicate variations, material shortages, or potential delays to Sales, Customer Service, and impacted departments.
• Partner with commercial and manufacturing teams during Sales and Operations Planning calls and collaborate on continuous improvement initiatives to drive on-time delivery throughout the product life cycle.

Education/Experience

• Associates degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field, plus a minimum of three (3) years of experience in production control, planning, and/or purchasing; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Material Requirement Planning (MRP) experience required.
• Association for Supply Chain Management (ASCM) certifications such as American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) or Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) a plus.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

• Supply Chain/Planning Skills. Knowledge of supply chain management, materials management and planning fundamentals, including operational management, purchasing, logistics, material requirements planning, inventory management, service scheduling and project management. Strong negotiation skills, including ability to influence and persuade others, develop reasoned arguments, listen and make decisions about how to allocate scarce resources. Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain vendor relationships through exceptional customer service. Working knowledge of cost accounting and manufacturing methods and procedures. Strong math, statistics and analytical thinking skills required.
• Production Planning Skills. Strong understanding of constraint-based management and demand-driven scheduling. Ability to quickly assess obstacles and offer solutions to meet company initiatives. Knowledge of basic mathematical concepts and principles. Ability to grasp machining concepts. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, Information Change Requests (ICR) and Material Requirement Planning (MRP). Skilled in applying continuous improvement methodologies.
• Communication Skills. Ability to speak clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations, listen and obtain clarification, and respond well to questions.
• Computer/Applications Skills. Proficient computer skills using a variety of software applications systems. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, including Word, advanced Excel (pivot tables), Access, SharePoint, and Teams. Working knowledge of MRP and CAPS (Capacity Planner) or equivalent systems.

Physical/Sensory Requirements

The following physical activities described here are representative of those required by a Team Member to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation, if feasible, will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions of position.

Must be able to sit for long periods-of-time, bend and reach, use stairs, lift up to 25 pounds occasionally and communicate effectively in English by telephone, in person and in writing. Effectively use a personal computer, office equipment and telephone.

Working Environment

While performing the essential responsibilities of this position, Team Member generally will work in an office environment. Occasional work in a manufacturing environment with frequent exposure to loud noise, moving mechanical parts, and fumes or airborne particles, and periodic exposure to outdoor environment through open doors.  PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) such as approved footwear, respirators, safety glasses/goggles, may be required.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Intern (Fall 2026)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. 


THE ROLE

We're looking for Software Engineering Interns to join Abridge's Engineering team for a 3-month internship program in Fall 2026, with the possibility of extension. You'll collaborate with our engineering team to build and ship real-world features that translate cutting-edge language model capabilities into dependable clinical systems. With mentorship and guidance, you'll gain hands-on experience designing, coding, and releasing AI-powered software that makes a meaningful impact on clinicians' workflows.



What You'll Do

 - Design and build end-to-end features, enhancing our existing systems and contributing to agentic LLM workflows (retrieval pipelines, structured tool use, chained LLM calls)

 - Fix user-facing bugs and issues, and make quality-of-life improvements across our backend and frontend systems

 - Get hands-on with evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, robustness, and clinical reliability

 - Help prototype with new models, prompting techniques, and open-source orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.)

 - Develop a strong user-centric mindset, building empathy for Abridge's clinicians and the challenges they face

 - Collaborate across cross-functional product teams — design, product, machine learning, and infrastructure — to ship features to our customers

 - Receive guidance from an experienced software engineering mentor, and collaborate one-on-one with teammates within your pod



What You'll Bring

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

 - A strong interest in pursuing a full-time software engineering role in 2027 — high-performing interns are eligible to receive a return offer

 - AI tooling is already part of how you work — you use it to write, debug, and learn faster, and you know when to trust it vs. verify

 - Passion for and understanding of Abridge's mission

 - A curious, adaptable, and proactive mindset, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment

 - A collaborative, low-ego mindset — we move fast, and we need team players who are eager to contribute wherever needed



Base Salary: $40/hr



Must be willing to work from our San Francisco (Potrero) office 5x per week.



This internship is based in our San Francisco office. Relocation will be supported through reimbursements.


WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

 - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

 - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

 - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

 - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

 - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

 - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

 - ... and much more!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.




STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Reporting to the Product Operations Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the growth and scaling of Ripple’s diverse product offerings. You will work closely with important internal teams such as Product, Trading, Risk, Treasury, and Engineering to make execution reliable, fast, and repeatable and to provide seamless support for Ripple’s 24x7 operations. • Become an expert in finance operational flows by working with key collaborators to detail existing processes.

• Support a globally distributed customer base for our 24x7 product offerings, including customer activity on weekends and holidays.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

• Relevant hands-on experience in operations and settlement, including reconciliation.

• High attention to detail with the ability to problem-solve and remain organised in a dynamic environment.

• Dedicated with a passion for efficiency and continuous improvement.

• Experience with implementing off-the-shelf and in-house solutions.

• Broad understanding of markets and instruments (cleared, OTC, crypto, derivatives).

Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the team:

The Stage Manufacturing team turns design into reality, owning the build of Terran R’s primary structures. This isn’t about turning the same bolt every day; it’s about building the systems to build the rocket. Engineers and technicians work side by side, with deep collaboration and real-time feedback, to shape how we build better and faster. With a manifest and a launch date, it’s up to the team to deliver on Terran R: solving challenges in real time, optimizing for scale, and constantly improving processes. As the vehicle evolves, so will the factory, with opportunities to apply automation, machine learning, and advanced technologies. What we build here sets the blueprint for the future of scaled launch.

About the role:

• Cover the shop floor for a primary structure assembly work center (or multiple), clearing barriers and keeping production moving

• Champion process improvements across multiple work centers to improve assembly operations and incorporate feedback and learnings from the first Terran R build

• Collaborate closely with a diverse team of engineers specializing in design, manufacturing, and reliability, as well as internal production teams and external vendors, leveraging their collective expertise to drive progress

• Create work instructions, specifications, and best practices across multiple high-fidelity processes. Help standardize processes across the manufacturing team.

• Provide Design for Manufacturing feedback to structures teams during the development phase and through the first prototype and flight builds

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing, aeronautical, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline

• 1+ years progressive and related experience required

• Hands on project history of supporting complicated assembly builds and capable of making risk decisions on a regular basis to disposition issues during build and keep production moving

• Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interface with engineering and manufacturing groups to understand process constraints and provide design inputs for improved manufacturability

• Strong engineering fundamentals in statics, mechanics of materials, process improvement/factory design, fastening and joining, machining

• Knowledge of common drilling and trim ops, other manufacturing processes, tools, inspection methods and GD&T

• Highly self-motivated and able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment

Nice to have:

• Direct experience with drill, trim and fastening operations for aerospace products

• New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success

• Experience in managing projects in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
jobs.location: US - Boston, MA ; US - Houston, TX
jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Job Title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
Location: US – Boston, MA, Houston, TX (Hybrid)

A quick snapshot…

Chief of Staff to the CEO, you’ll be a trusted partner to the CEO and lead the operating rhythm of the Office of the CEO. You’ll translate enterprise strategy into clear priorities, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes, creating visibility and accountability across Conga’s most important initiatives. Working as a peer partner to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), you’ll connect decisions, people, and information across functions, so issues are surfaced early, resolved quickly, and commitments move forward with discipline.

Why it’s a big deal…

This role is at the center of helping Conga execute on what matters most. You'll help create focus around our biggest priorities, improve the speed and quality of decision-making, and ensure our most important initiatives deliver results. By building a strong operating rhythm across the CEO, ELT, SLT, Board, and strategic initiative leaders, you'll bring greater visibility, alignment, and accountability to the business, helping us turn strategy into action and action into outcomes.

Here’s what we’re looking for...

• Enterprise execution. Own the portfolio and governance of Conga’s strategic priorities, translating direction into clear workstreams, accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.

• Executive operating cadence. Design and run an effective cadence for the CEO, ELT, and SLT, including agendas, pre-reads, decision frameworks, action tracking, and rigorous follow-through.

• KPI and business review discipline. Strengthen KPI, QBR, and enterprise business-review practices, so leaders have timely visibility into performance, risks, decisions, and required interventions.

• Board and executive preparation. Coordinate Board and executive materials, align with contributors and timelines, synthesize complex information into clear narratives, and ensure decisions and commitments are carried through.

• Cross-functional leadership. Drive initiatives where accountability spans multiple functions. Clarify ownership, expose gaps or duplication, manage dependencies, and keep teams aligned without creating an additional reporting layer.

• Decision-making and escalation. Make day-to-day decisions required to maintain momentum against agreed priorities, while escalating matters that require CEO or ELT judgment with clear options and recommendations.

• PMO leadership and alignment. Lead or closely align with the PMO to create a single, disciplined view of enterprise priorities, resource needs, delivery status, and risk.

• Trusted partnership. Build strong relationships across the ELT and broader organization, challenge constructively, and partner closely with the CEO’s Executive Assistant and functional leaders so the right people, information, and decisions come together at the right time.

• Senior-level experience. Significant experience in strategy, operations, transformation, PMO, or Chief of Staff leadership within a complex software or technology business.

• Business and financial acumen. Demonstrated ability to understand operating and financial drivers, evaluate trade-offs, connect metrics to enterprise priorities, and support sound executive decisions.

• Executive and Board effectiveness. Experience supporting senior executives and Boards, preparing high-stakes materials, and driving follow-through on enterprise commitments.

• Influence without direct authority. A track record of leading enterprise-wide initiatives through credibility, relationships, structured problem-solving, and disciplined execution.

• Executive communication. Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information and communicate directly, concisely, and appropriately for executive and Board audiences.

• Judgment and discretion. High integrity, sound judgment, and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with exceptional discretion.

• Leadership approach. Strong executive presence, a bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, organizational discipline, and the confidence to challenge constructively while building trust. You are highly collaborative, low ego, and relentlessly focused on outcomes.

Here’s what will give you an edge…

• Private equity experience, including familiarity with value-creation priorities, operating reviews, and investor expectations.

• M&A and integration experience, with a track record of aligning teams, operating models, priorities, and accountability through periods of change.

• Experience leading or partnering closely with an enterprise PMO in a global SaaS or technology organization.

• A record of improving executive operating rhythms, KPI systems, QBRs, or Board processes in a scaling or transforming business.

• Demonstrated alignment with the Conga Edge: Own the Outcome, Challenge the Norm, and Champion Each Other.

In the spirit of the Conga Edge, we strive to design easy-to-understand compensation programs that are fair and free from any type of discrimination.  In keeping with this approach, we are committed to delivering competitive compensation and benefits packages to our employees worldwide and communicating transparently about the structure of our compensation programs.

In addition to base salary, employees receive a variable incentive pay component, perks such as flexible work options, and a full range of benefits including medical and dental insurance.

The posted salary ranges are for the expectations outlined in the job description.  We are often open to a wide variety of profiles and sometimes have flexibility within our organizational structure to adjust the role responsibilities up or down should we select a candidate that is less or more experienced than the posted job requirements.  In these occasional cases, we will communicate the revised salary range to the candidate during the selection process.

U.S base salary range:

$204,499—$347,649 USD

Did we pique your interest?

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

Don’t meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

As one of the first hires on Suno's accounting team you'll be a true generalist, the person who can pick up whatever the close, the auditors, or the business throws your way and run with it. Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you'll own meaningful pieces of the monthly close, help carry the company through its first-year audit and toward IPO readiness, and bring a measured, meaningful approach to AI that unlocks the efficiency expected of a best-in-class team. We're looking for a doer who wants to build: someone who'll set up a process, document it, operate it, and then automate it. If you want broad exposure and the chance to shape how a fast-growing AI company does its accounting, this is the seat.

Listen to the song we made about the role: https://suno.com/s/sFjswHv402TX3Yeo




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and document repeatable processes across the accounting function, balancing startup flexibility with the rigor the business needs.

 - Support the company's first-year financial statement audit and help build toward the rigor required for IPO readiness.

 - Research technical accounting questions and support audit and tax requests with well-organized workpapers and analysis.

 - Put AI and automation to work across the accounting function, thoughtfully and with the right guardrails, to unlock the efficiency expected of a best-in-class team.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Must-Haves

 - Experience supporting external financial statement audits, first-year audit experience is ideal.

 - A demonstrated, measured use of AI and automation to make accounting faster and more accurate.

 - Builder's energy and the judgment to know when to apply rigor and when to stay flexible in a startup.

Nice-to-Haves

 - CPA.

 - Consumer tech or other high-volume revenue experience.

 - Exposure to music royalties, equity, indirect tax, or payroll accounting.

 - IPO readiness or SOX experience.




WORK LOCATION POLICY

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.




ADDITIONAL NOTES

 - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 - Willingness to travel (up to 10%) to collaborate with team members across Suno office locations.




PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Sandboxing
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every time Claude runs code, uses a computer, or works as an agent, it does so inside a sandbox. Our Sandboxing team builds the isolation layer behind that work. The same systems run the code Claude writes for users, the environments we train and evaluate models in, and the agents our customers deploy.

These workloads are untrusted by design, and there are a lot of them. Sandboxes need to start in milliseconds, hold up under adversarial code, and scale to a very large number of concurrent sessions. You will work at the boundary between the Linux kernel, virtualization, and the container ecosystem. You will partner with research, product, and security teams to make sure that safe and fast do not trade off against each other.

Key responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate the sandboxing infrastructure that runs untrusted, model-generated code and agent workloads at scale

• Improve sandbox startup time, density, and throughput, including snapshot and restore, checkpointing, and warm pools

• Strengthen isolation across compute, filesystem, and network, including egress controls and per-session credential handling

• Investigate and fix performance, reliability, and security issues at the kernel, hypervisor, and container runtime level

• Build the monitoring, tracing, and debugging tools that show where time and resources go inside a sandbox

• Work with researchers to support reinforcement learning environments and evaluations that need fast, reproducible, isolated execution

• Work with product and platform engineers to expose sandboxes as a dependable, well-designed capability for Claude products and customers

• Partner with security teams to threat-model the platform and to test, harden, and respond to escape and abuse scenarios

• Work with cloud providers on the hardware and platform features that our workloads depend on

• Share knowledge on systems programming and Linux internals, and help set technical standards for the team

Minimum qualifications

• Software engineering experience in Linux systems programming, kernel development, or another low-level area

• Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as Rust, C, C++, or Go

• Working knowledge of virtualization or container isolation technologies such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker, gVisor, or runc

• Understanding of Linux resource management, including namespaces, cgroups, scheduling, and memory management

• Experience profiling and debugging performance issues at the system level

• Ability to work in unfamiliar codebases and technical areas, and to ship practical solutions with measurable results

• Strong communication skills and a commitment to building safe, reliable systems

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building or operating a multi-tenant sandbox, serverless, or code execution platform

• Experience with microVMs, user-space kernels, or lightweight virtualization, including snapshot and restore

• Experience with OS-level security hardening, including seccomp, LSMs, and threat modeling of untrusted code

• Experience with eBPF and kernel tracing tools

• Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure at scale (AWS, GCP)

• Experience with network isolation, high-performance networking, or building egress proxies and policy layers

• Experience with sandboxes for AI agents, computer use, or reinforcement learning environments

• Experience with GPU virtualization, accelerators, or performance work on machine learning workloads

• Prior experience as a technical lead or mentor

Representative projects

• Cutting sandbox cold start from seconds to milliseconds with snapshot-based restore and pre-warmed pools

• Designing a network egress policy layer so agents can reach approved services without exposing secrets

• Running many thousands of parallel reinforcement learning environments with strong isolation between them

• Building tracing tools that attribute latency and resource use inside a running sandbox

• Reducing per-sandbox memory overhead to raise density on each host

• Hardening the runtime against escape attempts found in internal red-team exercises

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Financial Analyst

We're looking for a Financial Analyst to be a dedicated partner for our global teams. In this role, you'll be the go-to expert for managing sales expenses, headcount, and helping us make smart, data-driven decisions that fuel company growth. You'll work closely with Sales leadership to provide the financial insights they need to enable Ping Identity’s maximum top-line impact.

The Right Fit

This role is for someone who loves the details but also sees the bigger picture. You're a proactive problem-solver who jumps in to help teams find solutions. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and genuinely enjoy collaborating with others. The role is based out of our downtown Denver headquarters with an expectation of being in the office one day per week.

On our team, you'll find a group of people who are curious, accountable, and always working to make things better. We're looking for someone who shares that positive, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude. If you're looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team of bright, motivated peers, this is it. Join us and help shape the future of Ping Identity!

What You'll Do

• Manage expenses: Being integral part of the sales expense accrual process, collaborating directly with the team to ensure costs are captured accurately.

• Own the sales budget: Lead the forecasting and budgeting processes for all global sales teams and initiatives.

• Reconcile with precision: Dive into the details, meticulously reconciling budget vs. actuals and providing clear insights into spending trends.

• Process Improvement: Drive reporting consistency and simplification, streamlining how we track sales performance metrics and operational spend.

• Leverage Anaplan: Use Anaplan for all reporting, tracking, and analysis, helping to build a single source of truth for sales headcount and financials.

What You'll Bring

• 3+ years of experience in financial analysis, with a focus on expenses and headcount.

• A strong accounting foundation, with hands-on experience in managing accruals and expense recognition.

• Strong experience with budget vs. actual reconciliation, financial reporting, and forecasting.

• Direct experience with Anaplan for financial reporting and planning.

• You are an expert with Excel and comfortable building robust financial models.

• You have a bachelor’s degree in finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Salary Range: $80,000-$86,000

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

• Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

• Regular company and team bonding events.

• Competitive benefits and perks.

• Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

• Parental Leave

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Designer

Adyen is seeking a senior designer who is equally at home in a strategic brief and a craft critique. Please include a portfolio with your application. If your portfolio is password-protected, be sure to provide access details so we can review your work.

This San Francisco-based role is for someone who thrives on complexity — turning product features, campaign goals, and business priorities into intuitive, high-impact visuals anchored in Adyen's brand. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders, manage projects with rigor, and produce work that doesn't just look great but moves the business forward.

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) aux Directeurs Généraux des deux hôtels, vous êtes le partenaire stratégique et opérationnel des équipes de direction. Vous déployez la politique RH du Groupe et pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction sur le cluster, avec pour ambition de construire des équipes engagées, compétentes et fières de leur métier.

Vos responsabilités

Management et pilotage RH

• Définir et déployer la stratégie RH du cluster, en cohérence avec les standards Accor et les objectifs des deux établissements
• Conseiller et accompagner les Directeurs Généraux et les chefs de service dans leurs décisions managériales
• Manager et coacher l'équipe RH sur chaque site
• Suivre les indicateurs RH (effectifs, masse salariale, turnover, absentéisme, formation) et proposer des plans d'action

Paie et administration du personnel

• Superviser l'ensemble du processus de paie des deux hôtels : fiabilité, conformité, respect des échéances
• Garantir la bonne application de la législation congolaise du travail et des obligations sociales et fiscales (CNSS, INPP, ONEM, IPR, etc.)
• Maîtriser la gestion des contrats, des temps de travail, des congés et des mouvements de personnel
• Contribuer à la préparation et au suivi du budget masse salariale

Formation et développement des talents

• Construire et piloter le plan de formation du cluster, en s'appuyant sur les programmes et outils Accor
• Identifier les potentiels, structurer les parcours d'évolution et favoriser la promotion interne
• Développer l'employabilité des équipes locales et renforcer la culture du coaching
• Soutenir les managers dans leur rôle de développeurs de talents

Culture d'entreprise, relations sociales et recrutement

• Porter les valeurs Accor et animer une culture d'équipe positive, inclusive et orientée service
• Entretenir un dialogue social constructif avec les représentants du personnel et prévenir les conflits
• Piloter le recrutement et l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs, ainsi que la marque employeur sur le territoire
• Veiller à la santé, la sécurité et la qualité de vie au travail

Votre profil

• Formation supérieure (Bac+4/5) en Ressources Humaines, Droit social ou équivalent
• Expérience confirmée (minimum 5 à 7 ans) sur une fonction RH à responsabilité, idéalement dans l'hôtellerie ou un secteur de services à forte intensité de main-d'œuvre
• Solides compétences en paie et en administration du personnel (exigées)
• Forte présence terrain : vous êtes visible, accessible et proche des équipes, au quotidien dans les services
• Autonomie et sens de l'initiative : vous savez organiser votre travail et prendre des décisions sur deux sites distincts
• Appétence réelle pour la formation et le développement des équipes : vous aimez transmettre, coacher et faire grandir les talents
• Très bonne connaissance du droit du travail congolais ; une expérience en RDC ou en Afrique subsaharienne est un atout
• Leadership, sens de l'écoute, diplomatie et capacité à gérer des situations sensibles
• Maîtrise du français ; bon niveau d'anglais professionnel apprécié
• Disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents entre Lubumbashi et Kolwezi (environ 30 minutes de vol)

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un poste à responsabilités au sein d'un groupe hôtelier international de référence
• Un environnement stimulant, dans un marché porteur et en forte croissance
• Des opportunités de formation et d'évolution de carrière au sein du Groupe Accor, en RDC et à l'international
• Une rémunération attractive, selon profil et expérience
• Les avantages du programme Accor (dont les tarifs préférentiels dans le réseau mondial)

Comment postulez ? :

Envoyez votre CV et une lettre de motivation à marie.onya@accor.com, en précisant sur l'objet l'intitulé du poste "Directeur(trice) des Ressources Humaines Cluster".

Accor s'engage en faveur de la diversité et de l'égalité des chances. Toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention, sans distinction.

jobs.title: Lead Piercer
jobs.description:
Since 2015, Mejuri has reimagined what fine jewelry can be in a modern world—shifting it from a traditional gift to to a personal choice rooted in self-expression.

Founded by third-generation jeweller Noura Sakkijha, the brand was built on a simple idea: fine jewelry shouldn’t require a special occasion, and it should never come with guilt. It’s about celebrating yourself—your style, your life, your everyday.

Mejuri meets customers where they are—online, in app, and through a growing global retail footprint of 58+ stores worldwide. Mejuri is also deeply committed to doing things the right way, with responsible sourcing, sustainable practices, and philanthropic initiatives that reflect our values and long-term vision.

The Role:

At Mejuri, we’re not your run-of-the-mill piercing studio—we’re a vibrant community of artists, explorers, and jewelry enthusiasts. As we expand our reach across Canada, the US, UK, and Australia, we’re embarking on an exhilarating journey, and we want you to be part of it!

As our Piercing Lead, you’ll be the heartbeat of the Mejuri Piercing Studio. Your mission? Elevate customer service, boost profitability, and create an environment where jewelry dreams come true. Dive into the world of piercing and high-quality gems, knowing the ins and outs of initial piercings and allowable alloys. Safety and hygiene? We’ve got that covered too—our studio maintains the gold standard.

What Awaits You:

• Cutting-Edge Studios: Work with state-of-the-art equipment and studios that redefine the piercing experience. This includes needle piercing and gold and titanium jewelry.

• Collaboration and Learning: Network with fellow piercers, exchange insights, and elevate your craft.

• Mentorship: If you’re passionate about sharing knowledge, mentorship opportunities await.

• Flexible Roles: Whether you’re seeking full-time adventure or part-time excitement, we’ve got you covered. Interested in relocating to another market? We are open to discussing roles across all our locations.

• Compensation: Top wages in the industry including bonus, tip potential, and benefits (for full-time roles).

Customer Experience:

• Oversee the piercing customer journey from start to finish, including seamless greeting, check in, styling, transaction and service experience including aftercare education.

• Possess a calm and professional demeanour in piercing services to provide the best experience to piercing clients. Embody Mejuri values throughout every client interaction.

• Act as an ambassador of Mejuri and promote customer awareness about the brand and Mejuri’s piercing studios. Build a strong clientele in local market.

• Ensure insights and opportunities as they relate to piercing products and services are communicated back to the Store Manager & Store Services when necessary.

• Works closely with the Store Manager on consistent improvements to the flow and process of the Mejuri piercing studio.

• Work closely with store staff to update the schedule and online booking service.

• Explain proper aftercare to each client, well-inform each client of any signs and/or symptoms of infection within the following days/weeks/months of piercing. Tailor aftercare information to specific materials and individual downsizing information.

• Thoroughly explain service procedure and risks to clients. Identify any medical concerns which may prevent piercing before the service and include suggested care and any medical complications that may occur as a result of the procedure.

• On the sales floor you lead by example and validate the quality of the in-store customer experience by communicating, training, and upholding expectations on the team on Mejuri’s Steps of Selling.

• Ensure positive customer experience and promotion of services offerings including piercing, engraving, and other offerings.

Operations:

• Oversee and manage all aspects of the piercing studio, working closely with the Store Services team and Store Manager.

• Support inventory management and feedback with Operations Lead & Store Services team to ensure optimal quantities & assortment are available at the piercing studio at all times

• Ensure health and safety standards are maintained by following internal standards, and local guidelines. Ensure excellent cleanliness of the studio, maintenance of sharps and biohazard waste, and physical space requirements are met.

• Uphold legal compliance in all customer interactions including verifying proper identification, requirements, and waivers. Update Store Manager & Store Services Team on all local laws and protocol updates.

• Remain knowledgeable on Mejuri products and become an expert on the piercing jewelry assortment inclusive of labret sizing, materials, gemstones, and metals.

• Support the check up and downsizing process for each individual client.

• Style, stack, and suggest products for piercing clients. Provide expertise and planning to enable client to design their own ear stack

• Build piercing appointment occupancy through promoting, educating, and driving awareness of our piercing studio

• Communicate with Store Services to order necessary piercing equipment such as needles, latex-free gloves, sterilizer, alcohol pads, Q-Tips, paper towels, etc.

• Ensure all legislated paperwork and client record keeping is met and maintained at all times.

What you'll bring to the team:

• 2+ years experience with needle piercing.

• Experience working with threadless jewellery.

• Up to date with First Aid and Blood-borne Pathogens OSHA Certifications.

• Experience working with an autoclave or statim.

• Have or be registrable with local law enforcement or meet requirements by area for permits such as the “Practitioner Registration”, Blood-borne Pathogens, First Aid/CPR, Vaccination requirements etc.

• Understanding of local market piercing law requirements.

• Strong knowledge of health and safety protocols surrounding piercing procedures.

• Demonstrated understanding of service excellence in a consumer environment.

• Excellent communication & customer service skills.

• The desire to work in a fast paced, entrepreneurial environment.

• Bonus: you have experience selling product at a fast growing company

Benefits at Mejuri:

• US & CA ONLY: Comprehensive medical, dental, and mental health coverage, designed with flexibility, inclusivity & reproductive health in mind.

• US ONLY: Opportunity to utilize 401(k) & commuter benefits plans.

• UK ONLY: Comprehensive medical benefits including PMI, Cashplan, and Pension program

• Paid time off – inclusive of vacation and sick days.

• 4 months of 80% parental leave salary top-up and personalized return to work plans.

• You keep 100% of the tips you earn.

• Regular feedback via performance reviews.

• A robust in-house retail learning program

• Generous product discount!

#LI-Onsite

Looking for the perfect next opportunity is a big decision. Mejuri recognizes the importance of pay transparency when it comes to salary ranges as it empowers individuals through the hiring process and supports them in making an informed decision.
