jobs.title: Information Extraction Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT DEFCON AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

About the Role

You’ll pull structured facts out of long, free-text documents, and keep every one of them tied to the exact passage it came from. On this platform, nothing gets asserted without a citation a human reviewer can check, and that traceability is yours to build and protect.

You’ll join the analytics and AI engineering team behind a system that ingests records from dozens of disparate sources, resolves them to the right entity, and shows a human reviewer the exact source text behind every answer. Operating within a secure government cloud environment, the platform depends on extraction a reviewer can trust precisely because it can be checked against the original document.

You’ll join an established extraction practice rather than building one from scratch. The approach is set and reviewed by a senior practitioner on the team. Your contribution is sustained, consistent output at volume against long, messy, narrative documents that were never written with extraction in mind, and the judgment to flag what doesn’t fit rather than force it.

This is a fully remote role, with a later start date than our most urgent openings. We’re sourcing now so the seat is filled when the work begins.

Key Responsibilities

• Extract structured facts from long, free-text, narrative, and semi-structured documents

• Maintain a traceable pointer from every extracted fact back to the exact source passage it came from

• Validate that every cited passage actually supports the extracted fact, and treat a missing or unsupported citation as a defect

• Distinguish a stated total from a derived sum in financial narratives, retaining the contributing items and the calculation for verification

• Consume the recorded rule context supplied to model-assisted extraction, keeping cited facts and uncertainty separate from any validity decision

• Apply and extend the team’s established extraction approach consistently across new document types

• Handle ambiguous, contradictory, or incomplete source text without forcing a single reading; flag it rather than guessing

• Work with entity resolution and retrieval teammates on what a usable extracted fact needs to carry downstream

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years extracting structured facts or data from unstructured, narrative text in a production setting

• Experience keeping extracted output traceable to its source

• Strong Python, with hands-on NLP or information-extraction tooling, whether rule-based, statistical, or LLM-based

• US Citizenship Required

• Active US Secret clearance

Preferred Qualifications

• Extraction experience in a government, investigative, legal, financial-crime, or intelligence-adjacent setting

• LLM-based extraction with structured output schemas and validation against source text

• Experience where extracted facts fed a downstream matching, scoring, or retrieval system

• Active Top Secret clearance

What Success Looks Like

• Facts extracted at volume, with every claim traceable to its source passage

• Extraction that holds up when a subject-matter expert checks it against the original document

• Sustained throughput across new document types without re-deriving the approach for each one

What We Offer

• A fully remote, results-based environment

• Competitive salary, bonus, and equity package

• 100% employer paid, comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family

• Unlimited PTO, with your manager’s approval

• Flexible work environment where you manage your work day

• 14 weeks of fully-paid parental leave

Salary Range: $130,000—$160,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

These providers include applicant tracking systems, candidate verification platforms, and fraud detection tools (collectively, "Hiring Platforms"). jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT DEFCON AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

If your answer to “the two records disagree” is never overwrite, this role was built for you.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you’ll own the durable view of every resolved entity on the platform: the storage layer that holds what we know, where each fact came from, how confident we are in it, and how that picture has changed over time. When two sources disagree, both are kept with their evidence. When someone asks what we believed on a given date, and why, the platform can answer.

You’ll join the analytics and AI engineering team behind a system that ingests records from dozens of disparate sources, resolves them to the right entity, highlights what analysts should review first, and provides transparent, explainable recommendations that users can trust. Operating within a secure government cloud environment, the platform depends on a storage layer that never quietly erases a disagreement between sources.

Upstream matching is probabilistic. A match arrives with a confidence score rather than a yes, and the storage layer carries that uncertainty forward rather than collapsing it into one clean record. Sources change shape without warning and there is no shared key to join on, so this is a current data-engineering problem rather than a classic warehousing one.

The seniority this role calls for is about judgment, not tooling breadth: knowing why you never overwrite, and being able to reconstruct a past decision with its evidence a year later. If your instinct when records disagree is to preserve both and let a human decide, you’ll be at home here.

This is a fully remote role with occasional travel to DEFCON AI headquarters, customer sites, and partner facilities as needed.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and build the storage layer that preserves source disagreement and history rather than resolving them away at write time

• Build the first release’s result and evidence store: saved per-person results linked to the originating record, prior results and human feedback retained separately, and configuration versions on every result

• Implement provenance and lineage across every node and edge against the platform’s evidence-record contract

• Store the versioned rule library and configuration, and record on every result the exact rule versions and ordered context supplied to any model-assisted step

• Ensure every write is traceable to its origin and every decision is reproducible

• Carry match confidence and other uncertainty forward through the platform rather than collapsing it into a single value

• Support point-in-time questions: what did we believe about this entity on this date, and on what evidence

• Define, with entity resolution and ML teammates, what the storage layer needs to receive and what it must serve downstream

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years in data engineering or data platform engineering, including production experience with versioned, temporal, or historized data models

• Experience designing storage where history, provenance, and source disagreement are first-class rather than resolved away

• Comfort building on probabilistic upstream output rather than a clean shared key

• Strong Python and SQL, with production experience on PostgreSQL or comparable

• US Citizenship Required

• Active US Secret clearance

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building the storage layer downstream of an entity-resolution or record-linkage system

• Bi-temporal, event-sourced, graph, or temporal data modeling in production

• Federal, government, or regulated-industry experience where a historical decision had to be reproducible on demand

• Active Top Secret clearance

What Success Looks Like

• A durable view that never silently overwrites a disagreement between sources

• “What did we believe on this date, and on what evidence” is answerable a year later

• The storage layer holds up as probabilistic match output flows in, rather than assuming a clean join

What We Offer

• A fully remote, results-based environment

• Competitive salary, bonus, and equity package

• 100% employer paid, comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family

• Unlimited PTO, with your manager’s approval

• Flexible work environment where you manage your work day

• 14 weeks of fully-paid parental leave

Salary Range: $165,000—$200,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

Applicant Data Disclosure

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that Defcon AI uses third-party service providers to facilitate its recruitment and hiring processes. These providers include applicant tracking systems, candidate verification platforms, and fraud detection tools (collectively, "Hiring Platforms"). Your application materials, including your résumé, cover letter, work samples, responses to application questions, and any other information you submit, may be transmitted to and processed by these Hiring Platforms for the following purposes:

• Managing and administering your application throughout the hiring process;

• Identifying indicators of potentially fraudulent, fabricated, or materially misleading application content, including but not limited to discrepancies between submitted materials and publicly available professional profiles, geographic anomalies, and fabricated work histories.

Applications that are flagged through this process as containing indicators of fraud or material misrepresentation may be declined from further consideration. If you have questions about the status of your application or the evaluation process, please contact recruiting@defconai.com.

Defcon AI requires its Hiring Platform providers to process your information solely for the purposes described above and in accordance with applicable law. Your information will be retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes and any applicable legal obligations, after which it will be deleted in accordance with Defcon AI's data retention policies.

Business Unit/Department:  Loenbro West
Location: Billings, MT
Reports to:  Journeyman, Lead OR Foreman
Employment Type: Full Time
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary
Loenbro is looking for a dedicated and hardworking Construction Laborers / Helpers to join our team. The ideal candidate will assist in various construction tasks, ensuring projects are completed safely and efficiently. This is a physically demanding role that requires mindfulness and the ability to work well in a team.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Assist with the setup and cleanup of construction sites.

• Load and unload materials and equipment.

• Operate hand and power tools under supervision.

• Dig trenches, backfill excavations, and compact soil.

• Assist with the installation of construction materials, such as scaffolding.

• Follow safety protocols and maintain a clean work area.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• GED or High School Diploma.

• Ability to work from ladders and scaffolds.

• Lift & carry objects and materials of various weights.

Preferred:

• Skilled in math which includes adding and subtracting fractions.

• Able to pass preliminary and periodic drug testing.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Potential exposure to extreme cold and hot temperatures.

• Construction site environment.

• Limited working surfaces.

• Exposure to noise above 85 decibels and intense odors.

• Exposure to areas with limited visibility.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities. If you are ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions

Team & Development

• Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
• Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
• Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
• Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
• Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
• Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
• Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

• To be a successful and effective Department Supervisor, you’ll be an emerging leader who enjoys taking responsibility.
• You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
• You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $21.70-$25.28 hourly**

EEOC Code: SLS

Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly

jobs.title: Center-Based Registered Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $19 - $20

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism.

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team.

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squat, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

Perks of Working at Centria:

• Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis

• Discounts to hundreds of retail partners via our Benefit Hub

• Access to Centria’s Employee Assistance Plan with benefits around mental health and counseling

• Unlimited opportunities to make an impact in the life of a special needs child

• Early wage access to employees- Work today, get paid tomorrow with Rain!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, Veteran status, or disability status. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with the position. This pay scale range is the full range of potential wages Centria Autism reasonably expects to pay for employees with this job title and this pay scale range varies dependent on job qualifications, performance, experience, and/or seniority. This range should not be interrupted to mean that Centria Autism currently employs any employees with this job title at the bottom or top of the pay scale range. Centria reserves the right to amend this job description at any time, with or without written notice.

jobs.title: HR Professional
jobs.description:
HR Professionals here’s your chance to join a great Human Resources team and build valuable experience with an industry leader! We are seeking an individual experienced in all facets of HR who can lead, support and guide our Portage and LaPorte plants in all aspects of HR discipline. This is a great opportunity for a results-driven professional to advance their career! The successful Human Resource Generalist (HRG) is responsible for providing HR support in Employee/Labor Relations, Recruiting and Onboarding, Benefits, Training & Development, and policy compliance. This position will be responsible for our Portage and LaPorte, IN Facilities.

• Implement Human Resources policies and guidelines to meet organizations needs and to comply with state and federal laws.
• Support Labor Relations and collaborate with local leadership and union representatives.
• Manage the recruitment process for hourly positions: post openings, review applications and resumes, interview candidates, evaluate applicants.
• Conduct new employee orientation to insure employees gain an understanding of benefit plans, company policies and company procedures.
• Benefit administration to include claims resolution, benefit enrollments, terminations and assisting with Annual Open Enrollment
• Provide guidance to management on Compliance issues, Employee Training, Discipline and Terminations.
• Process complaints through proper investigatory procedures.
• Set up and process all new hire paperwork, to include entering applicant and new hire information into HRIS system.
• Initiate any type of employee change of status in appropriate system. (e.g., change of address, departmental transfers, rate increases, promotions, terminations, etc.)
• Verify HRIS data/payroll changes by generating a report from HRIS system.
• Compile and maintain employee records.
• Update employee files to document personnel actions and to provide information for payroll and other employment related uses.
• Examine employee files to answer inquiries and provides information to authorized people.
• Compile data from employee records, and HRIS system to prepare reports.
• Maintain and distribute current employee information, policy and procedure manuals, and other communication.
• Maintain records and generate reports pertaining to Affirmative Action Plan and other required compliance.
• Provides Employee Relations flow-through support for assigned area, assuring all communications and documents are correct and processed in a timely manner.
• Coordinate employee relations activities at the plant level to promote employee engagement. (Wellness Events, Service Award Programs, Recognition lunches, etc.)

The selected HR Professional will have:

• A high school diploma or GED is required. A degree or certification in HR or related field is strongly preferred
• A minimum of 3 years’ experience providing support in a human resources capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and experience is required
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, HRIS systems (ADP preferred), and use of the Internet is required
• General knowledge of employment laws and practices including labor law compliance, EEO, AA, and benefits programs
• Ability to maintain the highest level of discretion, diplomacy, and confidentiality
• Superior time management and accuracy
• Ability to interface with all levels of employees and management
• Effective oral and written communication skills
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to problem solve
• Confident team player – able to influence and persuade through strong presentation and communication skills
• 10% travel required

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Precoat Metals is a Drug Free Workplace

Position Summary

The Senior Financial Analyst is a key member of the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team, responsible for supporting executive leadership through financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, business performance analysis, and strategic decision support.

The Senior Financial Analyst will lead critical month-end reporting processes, develop executive-level financial presentations, and identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency and automation.

This role will serve as a trusted business partner to cross-functional leaders, translating financial results into actionable insights that support operational decisions and company-wide initiatives.

The ideal candidate possesses strong financial acumen, advanced analytical capabilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to influence business decisions through data-driven insights.

The candidate should be ambitious, intellectually curious, and eager to leverage emerging tools and technology to improve how financial insights are developed, communicated, and acted upon.

• Financial Planning & Analysis

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial analyses for executive leadership.

• Analyze financial results and drivers of performance, identifying risks and opportunities.

• Perform variance analysis comparing actual results to budget, forecast, and prior year performance.

• Support M&A integrations, new markets, acquisitions, and organizational changes through financial reporting and analysis.

Business Partnering

• Serve as a finance business partner to functional leaders, providing financial insights that support operational decision-making.

• Translate financial results, trends, and variances into clear recommendations for business stakeholders.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to understand business drivers, evaluate performance, and identify opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.

• Support leaders with ad hoc analysis, scenario modeling, and financial guidance for strategic initiatives.

jobs.title: Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit www.bugcrowd.com.

Job Summary

If you like owning problems end to end, making security a default property of everything we build, and working closely with engineering, we want to meet you. Bugcrowd is looking for security engineers who move beyond standard tooling and drive measurable security outcomes our customers can rely on. You will help us shape a culture where security helps others succeed, not just points out problems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Partner Closely with Engineering: Refine architecture, validate new features, and drive security investment while prioritizing engineering velocity

• Build Security Paved Roads: Contribute to the secure defaults, libraries, and "paved roads" that systematically eradicate entire classes of vulnerabilities rather than fixing bugs one by one

• Create Feedback Loops: Tune security tooling such as SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning to reduce noise and focus on what matters

• Be our Best Customer: Ensure our bug bounty program can be a model for other customers. Experiment with new ways to leverage the creativity of the crowd. Provide feedback on new platform features to engineering and product

• Own Projects End to End: Lead cross-functional product security projects from scoping through delivery, influencing product and engineering roadmaps and clearly communicating risk to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Amplify our Impact: Use code and automation as a lever to scale coverage and eliminate repetitive work. Build systems based on incentives and accountability rather than just bureaucratic process

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• 3+ years of experience in product security, application security, or secure software development

• Can review code, automate tasks, and build security tooling in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Ruby, Java)

• Hands-on experience with core application security practices — threat modeling, secure code review, and automated testing (SAST, DAST, SCA) — and a solid grasp of common vulnerability classes (e.g., OWASP Top 10)

• Demonstrated ability to manage projects and influence cross-functional partners across engineering, DevOps, and product.

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points (Preferred but not required)

• Previous experience with Bug Bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs

• A background in building "paved roads" or secure-by-default internal libraries to eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities

• Hands-on experience securing cloud-native platforms and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker)

• Experience working within a fast-paced, high-growth security or SaaS company

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

jobs.title: Vice President & General Manager, DSOA
jobs.description:
Vice President & General Manager, Dance Studio Owners Association

Department: Product & Strategy

Reports To: Chief Product Officer

Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid Required)

Overview

At TogetherWork, we set a high bar for clarity, collaboration, and execution. Our leaders own outcomes end to end, carry a number, and work in close partnership with Marketing, Revenue, Payments, CX, and the product teams serving the same customers. This is a business leadership seat in a member-facing coaching and community business, and the person in it is accountable for the growth and the health of that business.

The Dance Studio Owners Association (DSOA) is the largest community of dance studio owners in the world. DSOA teaches studio owners how to run profitable businesses through coaching, curriculum, events, and membership programs, and it sits alongside DanceStudio-Pro in the TogetherWork portfolio. This is a full business with its own P&L, its own brand, and a member base that expects expert guidance from people who understand the arts.

Our members are studio owners carrying payroll, staff, parents, and hundreds of kids on their shoulders, running a business they took on because they love dance. They come to DSOA for help with the part nobody taught them. We hold ourselves to one standard above the others: every member leaves us better than we found them.

We use AI deliberately and responsibly. AI carries operational load: research, drafting support, segmentation, analysis, and preparation. Curriculum, coaching, and member communication are authored and edited by people with real operating expertise, because members paying a premium price can tell the difference between a program built by experts and filler produced at volume. Leaders here are expected to know where AI improves the work and where it degrades it.

Hard work is the norm here, for the good of our customers and the long-term health of the company. This role reflects those expectations: accountable for revenue, credible with an arts-driven member community, data-informed, and grounded in professionalism and positive intent.

Role Summary

The Vice President & General Manager, DSOA owns the DSOA business end to end. That includes the P&L, membership growth and retention, the coaching organization, curriculum and programming, events, marketing performance in partnership with the TogetherWork marketing team, and day to day operations.

DSOA delivers coaching through a network of more than 30 coaches, mentors, and community leaders. This is a high-touch, premium coaching business where each member relationship carries significant annual value, so retention economics carry more weight than member count. Growing the coach network, in size and in quality, is the constraint on growing the business.

The business carries a defined margin target and an annual growth target, both set with the executive team. The longer-term purpose is to secure the studio software and payments relationship. Studio owners who coach with DSOA should stay on DanceStudio-Pro and process payments with TogetherWork at materially higher rates than studios who do not. This leader holds the margin and growth targets and sequences investment to protect software and payments retention.

The first two years include a rebuild of the member experience: a new membership portal, a refreshed DSOA brand and website, and a higher production standard for events.

The person in this seat is also the public face of DSOA to the dance and performing arts community, so credibility with studio owners matters as much as business judgment.

This is also a people job. The person in this seat coaches and develops the DSOA team, sets the tone for how coaches show up for members, and builds something durable: programs, systems, and a bench of talent that hold up long after any one leader moves on.

TogetherWork serves small business owners across a range of segments, and this leader will take part in exploratory research and planning for those segments.

Key Responsibilities

Business Ownership & P&L

• Own the DSOA P&L, including revenue, margin, and the annual operating plan.

• Build the annual growth plan and deliver the revenue growth and margin targets set with the executive team, with a monthly forecast.

• Define with Finance how software and payments contribution from DSOA members is attributed, and report combined member economics against it.

• Set pricing and packaging across membership tiers, coaching programs, events, and digital products.

• Own net revenue retention and average revenue per member as primary health metrics alongside new member growth.

• Decide where DSOA invests: programs, headcount, marketing spend, and partnerships.

• Identify new revenue lines, including sponsorship, certification, and expanded product offerings.

• Contribute to TogetherWork exploratory research and planning for other small business segments, bringing what the DSOA model shows about community, coaching, and retention.

Membership Growth, Benefits & Value

• Own member acquisition, activation, renewal, and lifetime value across all membership tiers, including Inner Circle.

• Reduce churn through onboarding, engagement programs, and member success practices.

• Deliver on the member value commitment at every tier.

• Define how member value is calculated and documented so the figure holds up to member scrutiny and to a renewal conversation.

• Design new benefit types and set what belongs in each tier, keeping a clear gap between standard and top tier so the upgrade is obvious.

• Manage cost to deliver against the value promise so added benefits do not erode margin.

• Grow revenue per member through program expansion, tier upgrades, and add-on offerings.

• Use member data, usage signals, and direct feedback to set the roadmap for programs and benefits.

• Build referral, community, and advocacy programs that bring new studio owners in.

• Partner with the DanceStudio-Pro team on cross-sell between software and membership.

Coach Network

• Build and lead the network of 30 plus coaches, mentors, and community leaders end to end: recruiting, onboarding, development, compensation, and performance management.

• Grow the network to meet member demand and program growth, with a sourcing pipeline that stays ahead of demand.

• Build a certification and onboarding standard so a new coach reaches full quality faster and the member experience stays consistent as the network grows.

• Test and benchmark coaches against defined standards on a set cadence, with recertification and quality metrics that measure member business outcomes and are visible to members and the business.

• Source coaches with credibility in new coaching domains as the program expands beyond studio operations.

• Develop the coaches themselves, with particular attention to business acumen so the guidance studio owners receive holds up financially.

• Design a compensation model that holds margin as the network scales and rewards member retention and outcomes.

• Manage coach capacity against member demand and program load, and keep a bench for growth and coverage.

• Resolve escalations and protect the member experience when coaching quality slips.

Member Experience, Brand & Platform

• Own the member experience end to end and set the roadmap for a new membership portal covering content, coaching, community, and program delivery in one place.

• Partner with TogetherWork Product and Engineering on the portal build: define requirements, prioritize releases, and hold the outcome.

• Lead a DSOA brand refresh and a new website, working with TogetherWork marketing and design.

• Raise the production standard of events, content, and member communication to match a premium price point.

• Define the member journey from first touch through renewal and set the standard for how members are supported at each stage.

Software & Payments Attach

• Build a joint motion with DanceStudio-Pro so DSOA membership and software reinforce each other in acquisition, onboarding, and renewal.

• Grow payments adoption and processing volume among DSOA members in partnership with the TogetherWork payments team.

• Use coaching engagements as a natural path to software and payments adoption, without turning coaching into a sales channel that members resent.

• Measure and report the retention and payments attach differential between DSOA members and non-member studios, track combined retention across membership, software, and payments, and use both to justify continued investment in coaching.

Coaching Portfolio & Curriculum

• Own the curriculum roadmap across live coaching, on-demand training, masterminds, and intensives.

• Expand the coaching portfolio beyond core studio operations into business growth, studio expansion, preparing for and executing a studio sale, student recruitment and enrollment growth, filling off-peak class times, managing slow seasons, and hiring and retaining teachers.

• Add owner wellbeing coaching covering burnout, workload, and resilience, with clear boundaries between coaching and licensed clinical care and a referral path when a member needs more than coaching.

• Add financial coaching covering pricing, cash flow, profitability, and owner compensation, structured to stay clear of regulated investment and tax advice.

• Decide which coaching domains DSOA staffs directly and which come through vetted partners.

• Refresh program content on a set cadence so material stays current with what studio owners are actually facing.

• Measure every program on completion rate, member outcome, and contribution to retention and revenue.

• Retire programs that do not perform and reallocate the investment.

Events, Conferences & Community

• Own an annual in-person conference end to end: format, content, speakers, sponsorship, attendance, and financial performance.

• Build a retreat program for top tier members, sized and priced to be a reason to stay at that tier.

• Run a virtual event calendar that keeps members engaged between in-person gatherings.

• Grow sponsorship and partner revenue against the event portfolio.

• Own the member community experience, including peer groups and the norms that keep the community worth belonging to.

Marketing & Brand

• Partner with TogetherWork marketing on demand generation, campaign performance, and funnel conversion for DSOA.

• Own the DSOA brand and voice in the dance and performing arts community.

• Serve as the forward-facing leader for studio owners, representing DSOA at industry conferences, competitions, and studio owner events.

• Build partnerships with dance organizations, vendors, and adjacent brands that add reach and revenue.

• Own the member content engine, including podcast, social, and email programs.

Team Leadership & Operations

• Lead the DSOA business day to day, across coaching, programming, community management, and operations, including a coach network of 30 plus.

• Coach and develop the team. Grow people into larger roles and build a bench so the business does not depend on any one person.

• Set the tone for how coaches and staff show up for members, including in the hard conversations about money, staffing, and whether a studio should keep going.

• Run the operating cadence: weekly metrics, monthly forecast, quarterly planning, and retrospectives.

• Replace informal processes with documented systems that hold up as the business grows.

• Set hiring plans, manage to budget, and make the call on structure as the business changes.

• Hold the team to TogetherWork standards on accountability, self-reflection, and speed.

Responsible Use of AI

• Hold the editorial standard for everything members receive, with a named human accountable for each piece.

• Set the rules for where AI is used at DSOA and where it is not, and enforce them as the team and the coach network grow.

• Use AI where it removes operational work: member segmentation, churn signals, feedback analysis, scheduling, research, and coach preparation.

• Use AI to support quality review of coaching sessions, with human judgment making the call on coach performance.

• Be transparent with members about where AI is part of the experience, and handle member data consistent with TogetherWork policy.

• Automate manual operational work so the team spends its time on coaching and member relationships.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Current or recent executive experience (President, CEO, General Manager, or VP) with full P&L accountability.

• Background in dance, the performing arts, or arts education, either professionally or as a studio or program operator.

• Experience leading a membership, community, or association-based business, with accountability for growth and retention.

• Direct experience with coaching or mentoring programs, as a coach, a program leader, or the leader of a coaching organization.

• Track record of holding a margin target while funding growth, including the judgment to sequence investment instead of funding everything at once.

• Experience with a business model where part of the monetization sits outside the immediate P&L, such as attach, cross-sell, or ecosystem economics.

• Experience leading a brand refresh, website relaunch, or customer-facing platform launch.

• Experience designing membership tiers and benefit packages, including how value is defined, priced, and defended at renewal.

• Experience producing in-person conferences, retreats, or large member events with accountability for content quality and event P&L.

• Experience building and managing a distributed network of coaches, mentors, contractors, or affiliated practitioners, including recruiting, quality standards, and compensation design.

• Business acumen across pricing, forecasting, budget management, and P&L analysis.

• Experience with a high-value recurring revenue model, where individual customer or member relationships are worth thousands of dollars a year and retention determines the outcome.

• Marketing fluency across demand generation, brand, events, and sponsorship or partnership revenue.

• Track record of building teams and installing systems where processes were informal or undocumented.

• Working fluency with AI tools, and the judgment to know where AI improves a program and where it produces filler that a paying member will notice.

• Strong public presence and communication skills. This role is visible to members and to the industry.

• Willing to travel for DSOA events, industry conferences, and member gatherings.

• Must be located in Austin, TX. Hybrid work required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience serving SMB owner-operators, particularly in service businesses.

• Experience in a private equity backed or multi-brand portfolio company.

• Understanding of where coaching ends and regulated practice begins in wellbeing and financial advice, and how to structure programs accordingly.

• Experience with high-ticket coaching, mastermind, or premium membership programs.

• Experience with digital education, online course, or certification businesses.

• Experience with sponsorship sales, event revenue, or partnership development.

• Familiarity with dance studio management software or comparable vertical SaaS.

• Experience launching a new line of business or entering a new market segment.

Interview Integrity & Use of AI

We value authenticity, expertise, and real-time problem solving during our interview process. Candidates are expected to represent their own knowledge, experience, and thinking without the use of AI-assisted tools during interviews.

The use of any AI tools during interviews, including real-time scripting, recording, transcription, response generation, or coaching tools, is strictly prohibited. This applies to phone, video, in-person, and case-based interviews.

We strongly value candidates who understand how to use AI tools effectively and responsibly, and this role requires that fluency. Interviews still need to reflect the candidate’s own abilities and perspectives. Any candidate found using AI-assisted tools during the interview process will be immediately disqualified from consideration.

Our Commitment to Members

Members are the reason this role exists. TogetherWork is investing in DSOA leadership, programs, platform, and events because studio owners deserve a community that keeps getting better rather than one coasting on what worked five years ago. That investment should be visible in the coaching members receive, the tools they get, and the events they attend.

The person in this seat is accountable for that, and for the standard behind it. Every member leaves us better than we found them.

Why This Role Matters

DSOA is where TogetherWork earns trust with dance studio owners before, during, and beyond the software relationship. At a premium annual price, coaching quality is the product and retention determines the financial outcome. The strategic case is larger than the coaching revenue: a studio owner who coaches with DSOA, runs the studio on TogetherWork software, and processes payments with us is the most durable relationship in the portfolio, and the hardest for a competitor to take. The leader in this seat holds the margin and growth targets, decides whether the coach network scales without losing quality, and determines whether members stay. Done well, this leader leaves behind a coaching organization, a member experience, and programs that keep serving studio owners for years.

jobs.title: Environmental Technician
jobs.description:
This position is located at a Semiconductor Manufacturing Facility.

Position Purpose:

Work is performed in industrial settings including: assembly plants, metal fabrication plants, refineries, and power train plants. Collect, sort and transport disposables and recyclables including: trash, hazardous waste, scrap metal and other waste streams throughout a facility to designated container and location.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Maintain a safe, neat and clean work environment this includes: work area, equipment, locker rooms, break rooms, and office areas.
• Model professional behavior at all times; report to work as scheduled, on time and prepared to work.
• Collect trash, recyclables and hazardous waste from various locations throughout the facility.
• Breakdown scrap parts for repair or recycling.
• Transport waste/recyclables to disposal container and/or storage location.
• Load semi-trailers and roll-off boxes for shipment to landfill or recycling center.
• Maintain storage areas, and drum pads in accordance to regulations.
• Document and inform the manager or designated person of any contamination in recycling containers.
• Complete reports and documentation correctly and submit timely as directed.
• Participate in meetings to access the work environment for safety and effectiveness.

• Demonstrate a commitment to learning and development; stay current of safe work practices, policies and regulations.
• Work effectively in a team environment and provide support and assistance to others.
• Commitment to promoting and creating a safety culture and positive work environment.

Must be able to work in loud, cold, hot, wet, and dry environments.

• Able to read and understand instructions in English.

• Must have a valid driver’s license.
• Successfully complete drug screen and pre-employment physical, safety sensitive background check.

• Push/pull and frequently lift and carry up to 40 lbs.

• Lift, carry, push or pull equipment of various size, shape, and weight.

jobs.title: Behavior Technician - Work with Kids - Training Provided
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $19 - $20

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism.

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team.

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squat, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

• Discounts to hundreds of retail partners via our Benefit Hub

• Access to Centria’s Employee Assistance Plan with benefits around mental health and counseling

• Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

• Unlimited opportunities to make an impact in the life of a special needs child

As a veterinary receptionist, you’ll help keep our front desk running smoothly while providing exceptional customer service to our clients and their pets. Your responsibilities will include:

• Answer incoming calls and emails, respond to questions, and direct client concerns to the appropriate team member.

• A self-starter mindset and desire to continue developing your veterinary knowledge and customer service skills.

Whether you’re looking to build your veterinary career, gain more experience in a veterinary hospital, or simply find a team where you can make a difference, we want to help you grow. jobs.title: Social Worker - Learning Disabilities Review Project
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Social Worker for its client's Learning Disabilities Review Project at Cambridgeshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled practitioner to work within a county-wide specialist team supporting adults with Learning Disabilities and Autism (LD&A). The role focuses on reviewing complex and high-cost care packages to ensure they continue to meet individual needs, deliver positive outcomes, promote independence, and provide value for public resources.

Working closely with Senior Social Workers, Contracts Teams, Brokerage Services, individuals, families, carers, and advocacy services, you will undertake comprehensive reviews and assessments of existing support arrangements. The successful candidate will be experienced in strengths-based and person-centred practice, with the ability to analyse complex situations and make evidence-based recommendations that improve outcomes and maximise wellbeing.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Completing Care Act 2014 assessments for adults with Learning Disabilities and Autism, including cases involving complex and high-cost care packages.

• Undertaking timely reviews following changes in an individual's needs, circumstances, or support arrangements.

• Reviewing care and support packages to ensure they remain proportionate, effective, outcome-focused, and represent value for money.

• Delivering a minimum of two completed and recorded assessments per week.

• Conducting face-to-face assessments and reviews with individuals and their support networks.

• Working closely with advocates, carers, families, providers, and partner agencies to ensure a person-centred approach to assessment and care planning.

• Analysing and evaluating care and support arrangements to identify strengths, risks, gaps, and opportunities for improved outcomes.

• Collaborating with Contracts and Brokerage Teams to develop cost-effective and appropriate support solutions.

• Promoting independence, wellbeing, choice, and control through strengths-based interventions and support planning.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and contributing to Best Interest decision-making where required.

• Maintaining accurate, defensible, and timely records, assessments, reviews, and professional reports.

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have,

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care.

• Learning Disabilities & Autism Experience: Proven experience working with adults with Learning Disabilities and Autism.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014 and Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Assessment Skills: Experience undertaking complex assessments, reviews, and evaluations of care and support arrangements.

• Care Package Reviews: Experience reviewing complex and high-cost care packages and making evidence-based recommendations.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with brokerage teams, contracts teams, providers, carers, advocates, and partner agencies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent assessment, analytical, report-writing, and professional communication skills.

• Driving Licence: Access to your own vehicle is essential.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

jobs.title: Sales Director, Media and Agencies
jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

Reporting to the General Manager of Media & Advertising, you will lead and cultivate business development and sales across multiple teams within agency accounts and consistently find opportunities to help them increase revenue, market advantage and customer loyalty. Leveraging HealthVerity’s vast network of healthcare and consumer data suppliers, as well as partnerships and linkages with media entities, you will strengthen agency capabilities throughout the customer life cycle from research to support new business pitches all the way through to commercial engagements.  Through your mastery of data, identity, digital media, marketing analytics, and multi-channel patient engagement, you’ll become a trusted advisor and bring business value and thought leadership to HealthVerity’s agency partnerships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Position yourself as a media, advertising, and healthcare data subject matter expert, driving new business and account management between HealthVerity and our key agency and media accounts

• Expand HealthVerity’s presence through prospecting and relationship building, identifying opportunities to drive new revenue for our Audiences targeting and Media Measurement business line

• Confidently and credibly present our Audiences targeting and media measurement product presentations, demonstrations, lunch & learns, conference calls, technical discussions/due diligence, executive discussions, web seminars and related activities

• Prepare, present and coordinate product proposals, RFIs, RFPs and related sales activities

• Coordinate all sales efforts with sales support and delivery on account status, follow up activities, audience activation, inbound leads, product literature, win-loss and related sales support tasks

• Support strategy development and direction of overall business line through customer feedback, market awareness, and competitive insights

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• 5+ years of experience and a proven track record in healthcare adtech or agency sales

• Experience marketing and selling complex solutions leveraging real-world healthcare data, advertising analytics, or adtech technology to digital agencies and life sciences media customers

• Demonstrating success in developing and growing strong agency or life sciences & healthcare media relationships

• Leading contract negotiations and closing new and renewing B2B opportunities with large enterprise customers and their respective teams

• Succeed as a creative prospector, comfortable with networking and cold calling, walking the halls of agency accounts and developing deep relationships with key stakeholders

• Up to 30% travel required for this role

Preferred

• Understand the challenges in pharmaceutical marketing and can contribute innovative ideas to agency accounts on how best to utilize identity resolution, data, and technology to optimize marketing strategy

• Thrive in a fast paced environment that requires extensive self direction

• Effortlessly and quickly communicate updates, blockers, and challenges

• Past history with a consistent track record of annual quota/revenue achievement

Base salary for the role is commensurate with experience and can range between $125,000 - 160,000 + incentive compensation plan

Hiring Locations

Our main office is located in Center City, Philadelphia, where we operate on a hybrid model with in-office work required three days a week for local employees. We believe collaboration is most effective when teams come together, which is why we prioritize hiring in the Philadelphia area.

For certain roles, we also hire from hub locations—regions where we have an established presence with multiple team members working remotely. While these employees primarily work from home, we bring them together in person at least once a year for team-building, collaboration, and strategic planning.

Due to tax and labor regulations, we can only hire from specific states. Remote work is supported in the following key hub locations and approved states:

Hub Locations:

• Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

• Boston, Massachusetts

• New York City, New York

• Baltimore, Maryland

• Washington, D.C.

• Charlotte, North Carolina

• Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina

• Atlanta, Georgia

• Chicago, Illinois

Approved States for Remote Work:
CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TN, and VA.

About HealthVerity

HealthVerity is the leader in privacy-protected real-world data exchange, transforming how healthcare and life sciences organizations connect and analyze disparate patient data. By enabling access to the industry’s largest RWD ecosystem, HealthVerity supports critical applications in clinical development, commercial strategy, regulatory decision-making, and public health. To learn more about HealthVerity, visit healthverity.com.

Why you'll love working here

We are making a difference – Our technology is at the forefront of some of the biggest healthcare challenges in the world.

We are one team – Our people define our culture and always will. We take time out to celebrate each other, and acknowledge the value that each of us adds towards our greater mission. Come share all you have to offer.

We are learners – Every team member is continually learning, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or much longer. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our clients, partners, and each other.

Benefits & Perks

Our benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support and enrich the experience of our full-time employees, with eligibility limited to those in permanent positions.

• Compensation: competitive base salary & annual bonus opportunity (for non-commissioned roles)

• Benefits: We offer health, dental, and vision coverage starting on day 1. We also offer a 401(k) plan and an equity program, with new hire equity grants beginning at the Director level and above.

• Flexible location: Remote workdays and 3 days a week of in-office collaboration for team members in the Philadelphia area. Check location requirements with the recruiting team.

• Generous PTO: Take time off as needed, targeted at 4 weeks per year, including vacation, personal and sick time, plus paid parental leave.

• Parental Leave: 12 weeks paid leave for childbearing, surrogacy, and adoption; 6 weeks for non-childbearing parents.

• Comprehensive and individualized onboarding: mentorship program, departmental talks, and a library of resources are available beginning day 1 for each new team member to minimize the stress of starting a new job

• Professional development: biweekly 1:1s, hands-on leadership that is goal-and growth-oriented for each team member, and an annual budget to support professional development pursuits

We believe incorporating different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds make us stronger and encourages an environment where ageism, racism, sexism, ableism, homophobia, transphobia or any other form of discrimination are not tolerated. All qualified job applicants will be given consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. At HealthVerity, we’re working towards an innovative and connected future for healthcare data and believe the future is better together. We can only do that if everyone has a seat at the table.

If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to careers@healthverity.com

Remote opportunities are not available in all areas and require team members to work from a fixed location due to tax and labor law implications - specific questions about remote positions can be discussed during the interview process with your recruiter.

jobs.title: Child Autism Specialist - We Train You
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $19 - $20

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism.

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team.

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squat, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

• Bilingual in Spanish

Perks of Working at Centria:

• Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis

• Discounts to hundreds of retail partners via our Benefit Hub

• Access to Centria’s Employee Assistance Plan with benefits around mental health and counseling

• Unlimited opportunities to make an impact in the life of a special needs child

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, Veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Product Support - Bridge
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper than SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that improves global money movement.

What you'll do

As part of our growing Product Support team, you will be a critical driver in delivering outstanding user experiences. This role goes beyond basic troubleshooting—it's about using your technical expertise, diagnostic mindset, and project management skills to improve our support systems, processes, and product quality.

You will own complex technical user issues and coordinate with cross-functional teams, including Engineering and Product, to drive them to resolution. A deep understanding of SQL and APIs will allow you to engage with these teams effectively, analyze data to inform decisions, and propose solutions that drive operational efficiency. Your work will focus on scaling support operations, creating better user experiences, and driving continuous improvements.

Responsibilities

• Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues through direct user interaction, using SQL to extract and interpret data alongside API documentation.

• Develop product and platform expertise, working closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to diagnose and resolve user issues.

• Optimize and scale support processes to enhance efficiency and improve the overall user experience, incorporating data-driven insights and metrics.

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives aimed at achieving key performance metrics such as Consumer Satisfaction (CSAT), Contact Rate, and service-level compliance.

• Create and refine documentation to empower users to resolve issues through self-service, reducing dependency on support teams.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to advocate for platform improvements based on user feedback and ensure long-term product reliability.

• Lead cross-functional projects aimed at identifying inefficiencies in current processes and driving the implementation of long-term solutions.

• Challenge the status quo and drive innovation in user support strategies and operational processes.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing product support role, with a focus on troubleshooting technical issues.

• Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and querying, with the ability to interpret datasets.

• Experience working with APIs.

• Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex issues and drive them to resolution.

• Proven experience in stakeholder management, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive progress.

• Experience in project management, particularly in optimizing processes, workflows, or support operations.

Preferred qualifications

• Strong data analysis skills, with a passion for interpreting data to improve decision-making.

• Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proficiency in technical environments and the ability to diagnose and resolve highly technical user issues.

jobs.title: Maintenance Supervisor
jobs.description:
Pay:  $130K+/yr average pay ($46–$48/hr + OT) + year-end bonus

Schedule: Monday – Friday 7:30am-5:30pm (schedule can vary)

Responsibilities:

• Plan and oversee daily maintenance activities, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and emergency repairs across all shifts.
• Repair, install and dismantle machinery and equipment according to plans which involves working at heights, climbing ladders and using mobile equipment (cranes, forklift, scissor lift, etc.).
• Plan and lead maintenance teams and external vendors during plant shutdowns and equipment installations.

• Train multi-craft maintenance technicians, ensuring that all employees have the necessary skills and knowledge to perform their duties effectively.

• Test electrical systems and continuity of circuits in electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures, using testing devices such as ohmmeters, voltmeters, and oscilloscopes.

• Lead breakdown response and troubleshooting efforts and prioritize critical repairs to minimize downtime.

• Connect to PLC’s and VFD’s using laptop software to identify faults, monitor inputs/outputs, and support production troubleshooting.

• Support welding, fabrication, and equipment modifications as needed.

• Identify and upgrade electrical components (VFD’s, I/O cards, PLC’s, etc.) to ensure proper inventory of spare parts are readily available.

• Reads and understands wiring diagrams to trace electrical circuits; IO’s, OL’s, contactors, relays, break resisters and various other electrical components.

• Manage and oversee outside contractors, vendors, and service providers performing work onsite.

• Develop and improve preventive and predictive maintenance procedures in WO system.

• 5+ years of heavy industrial maintenance experience
• 2+ years of leadership or supervisory experience
• Proven experience leading teams in both electrical and mechanical systems.
• Experience troubleshooting/set up of VFD drives; SEW drives, Siemen, Lenze, & Allen Bradley
• Experience in concrete, foundries, aggregates, mining, or other heavy industrial manufacturing operations (preferred)
• Industrial electrical experience in PLC’s and plant automation.
• Ability to support multiple shifts
• Experienced in heavy industrial mechanical repairs; rigging, welding & fabrication (preferred)
• Experience with Microsoft Office, CMMS, & ERP systems
• Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills

Why Join Techo-Bloc?

Techo-Bloc offers its valued associates a competitive salary, paid time off and a comprehensive benefits package.  Here are a few of our perks:

✔ Medical, dental, and vision coverage

✔ Company-paid short-term disability
