jobs.description:
At Duna, we see the company as the second product we're building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.


Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We're backed by world-class investors including CapitalG and Index Ventures, as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI and Goldman Sachs.

Since your role with us will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING IN THIS ROLE

 - Work closely with customers to help them successfully implement and use Duna’s product

 - Act as the technical point of contact for integrations, onboarding, and product rollouts

 - Technically scope requirements early in the implementation process

 - Troubleshoot implementation issues and guide customers toward scalable solutions

 - Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and growth to improve implementation flows and customer experience

 - Help shape how Duna works with customers by improving documentation, tooling, and processes



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Comfortable working at the intersection of technology, product, and customers

 - Clear communicator who enjoys explaining complex ideas in simple, human terms

 - Strong problem solver who stays calm in ambiguous or fast-moving situations

 - Systems thinker — you understand how customer decisions impact the product and vice versa


Our current stack includes Node.js + TypeScript, React, Event Sourcing, Express, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, and AWS. Familiarity with modern web technologies or technical integrations is a plus, but not required. We care more about how you think, how you communicate, and how you help customers succeed.


A final note before you apply: please read through our website in detail. You'll find the fundamentals there: what we believe in, how we work, and why we're building this company.


We're a remote-first, fast-moving team of builders looking for exceptional people who love to create, build, and ship. Beyond passion and grit, we highly value curiosity, authenticity and kindness.


If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!


PS. We are looking to hire passionate people from a variety of backgrounds. So even if you don't check all the boxes, we welcome your application!

jobs.title: Store Manager – Beverwijk (38 uur)
jobs.description:
WAT JE GAAT DOEN

Als Store Manager draag je de eindverantwoordelijkheid voor de winkel en geef je leiding aan je team met als doel een inspirerende, inclusieve en high-performing werkomgeving te creëren. Je zorgt voor een uitstekende operationele én visuele klantbeleving en stimuleert actief samenwerking en ondernemerschap op alle niveaus.

Jij:

• bent verantwoordelijk voor de totale klantervaring in de winkel, zorgt voor een sterke visuele en commerciële presentatie en implementeert servicetools om klantloyaliteit te versterken.
• analyseert verkoop- en budgetdoelen, leidt gerichte optimalisaties af en implementeert deze samen met je team – terwijl je kostenbewust de winkel onderhoudt en alle middelen efficiënt inzet.
• plant taken en personeelsinzet efficiënt in en zorgt voor een soepele uitvoering van alle operationele processen – van de winkelvloer en het magazijn tot aan de kassa’s, paskamerroutines en dagelijkse winkelopening en -sluiting.
• ontwikkelt je team strategisch via werving, onboarding, regelmatige feedbackgesprekken, individuele ontwikkeling en opvolgingsplanning – en versterkt motivatie, teamspirit en een prestatiegerichte cultuur.
• volgt actuele modetrends en relevante influencers met een scherp gevoel voor stijl, en zorgt ervoor dat je team deze kennis doelgericht toepast in het contact met klanten.

Wil je meer weten over de rol van Store Manager? Luister naar onze Jobcast-aflevering en ontdek meer over de functie uit eerste hand – rechtstreeks van ons team: Store Manager.

Zodra je op de link klikt, verlaat je onze site en word je doorgestuurd naar Spotify. Je vindt het privacybeleid van Spotify AB hier: Privacybeleid - Spotify.

MET WIE JE GAAT SAMENWERKEN

Onze winkels vormen het hart van H&M – daar waar klanten het merk van dichtbij beleven. Elk teamlid draagt bij aan een inspirerende en gastvrije sfeer. Je werkt nauw samen met je team om onze klanten te helpen zich zelfverzekerd te voelen en zichzelf te uiten met de nieuwste trends en tijdloze stijlen.

WIE JIJ BENT

Wij zoeken talenten met...

• Ervaring in het aansturen en organiseren van een retailwinkel.
• Ervaring in het coachen en strategisch ontwikkelen van een team.
• Sterke plannings- en prioriteringsvaardigheden.
• Zelfverzekerde omgang met verkoopplanning, analyses en opvolging.

En talenten die...

• Op een inspirerende en duidelijke manier communiceren, en actief en met empathie luisteren.
• Ambitieus, prestatiegericht en vastberaden zijn.
• Analytisch denken, flexibel en oplossingsgericht handelen, en een scherp gevoel hebben voor cijfers en verbanden.
• Een uitstekende klantervaring creëren met veel inzet en teamspirit, actief verkoop stimuleren en het hele team motiveren om het beste uit zichzelf te halen.
• Passie hebben voor mode, trends en commercie.

WIE WIJ ZIJN

De H&M Group is een wereldwijd bedrijf met sterke modemerken en innovatieve businesslijnen. Wij geloven dat excellent design, betaalbare prijzen en duurzame oplossingen hand in hand kunnen gaan. Onze klanten staan centraal in alles wat we doen. Onze bedrijfscultuur wordt gevormd door duizenden gepassioneerde en getalenteerde teamleden. Samen gebruiken we onze schaal en kennis om de mode-industrie te leiden richting een inclusievere en duurzamere toekomst.

WAAROM JE HIER GRAAG WILT WERKEN

We zijn trots op ons levendige en open karakter. Onze teams profiteren van aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en diverse ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden wereldwijd.

• Personeelskorting op al onze producten en merken
• 25 vakantiedagen
• HIP – H&M Incentive Program (bonusprogramma)
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) voor een gezonde werk-privébalans
• Corporate Benefits (exclusieve kortingen bij veel merken)
• Bedrijfspensioenregeling
• Reiskostenvergoeding
• Contract van 1 jaar met uitzicht op verlenging

KOM ERBIJ

Onze kracht en uniciteit zitten in veel dingen – in onze inclusieve cultuur, onze sterke waarden en onze ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Maar bovenal zijn het onze teams die ons maken tot wat we zijn.

*Meer informatie over de verwerking van jouw persoonlijke gegevens vind je in onze mededeling over gegevensbescherming.

** We streven naar een eerlijk en gelijk proces en vragen je geen sollicitatiebrief mee te sturen, omdat deze vaak informatie bevat die gemakkelijk kan leiden tot onbedoelde vooroordelen.

***Om het grote aantal sollicitaties voor functies met leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheden te beheren, gebruiken we een online beoordelingsmethode. Je moet deze voltooien als onderdeel van het sollicitatie- en screeningsproces. Je antwoorden worden gescoord door een beoordelingstool die vooraf gedefinieerde criteria toepast die door H&M Group zijn vastgesteld.

Na het voltooien van de beoordeling krijg je de mogelijkheid om feedback te delen en vragen te stellen.

Als je problemen ervaart of de voorkeur geeft aan een alternatieve beoordelingsmethode, neem dan contact op met recruitment_support@hm.com. Het kiezen van een alternatief heeft geen invloed op je sollicitatie. Raadpleeg onze Privacyverklaring voor meer informatie over hoe we je persoonsgegevens verwerken.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support - Contractor
jobs.description:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, trusted by over 200 million people worldwide to securely manage and grow their digital assets. Our vision is to give individuals the freedom to own their assets, confidently participate in the future economy, and access opportunities that enhance their lives. Our mission is to be a trusted personal companion — helping users safely navigate Web3, the on-chain economy, and the emerging AI-powered future. With support for over 10 million assets across 100+ blockchains, Trust Wallet offers a seamless, multi-chain experience backed by industry-leading self-custody technology, a vibrant community, and a growing ecosystem of partners.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a proactive and technically curious Technical Customer Support Contractor (6 months) to join our team. In this role, you will go beyond traditional customer support by combining user-facing communication with technical investigation, system awareness, and operational ownership.

You will play a key role in ensuring a smooth user experience by identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving issues across wallet functionality, payment systems, and backend services, while also contributing to incident response, monitoring, and operational improvements.




RESPONSIBILITIES


CUSTOMER SUPPORT & TECHNICAL TRIAGE

 - Provide timely and effective support to users via email and other support channels, resolving inquiries related to wallet functionality, card payments, transactions, and security.

 - Perform technical triage of user-reported issues, identifying whether problems originate from client applications, APIs, backend services, or external providers.

 - Investigate and troubleshoot issues using internal tools, logs, dashboards, and available system data.

 - Escalate complex or critical issues with clear, structured context, including reproduction steps, logs, and impact assessment.


MONITORING & INCIDENT SUPPORT

 - Monitor system behavior and identify anomalies such as increased error rates, transaction failures, or performance degradation.

 - Assist in incident response, including investigation, user communication, and resolution tracking.

 - Support post-incident reviews by documenting findings and contributing to continuous improvement efforts.

 - Follow defined escalation processes for high-severity issues.


OPERATIONS & SYSTEM AWARENESS

 - Analyze logs and system signals to help identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues.

 - Support proactive monitoring of key system metrics (latency, error rates, transaction success rates).

 - Assist in coordinating with internal teams and external providers during service disruptions.

 - Track and follow up on unresolved issues to ensure timely resolution.


ACCESS & PROCESS SUPPORT

 - Assist with access-related requests and follow established procedures for onboarding and offboarding activities.

 - Support periodic access reviews and contribute to maintaining secure operational practices.


CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION

 - Work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to resolve issues and improve system performance.

 - Provide structured inputs (logs, user impact, reproduction steps) to accelerate debugging and resolution.

 - Act as a bridge between users and internal teams during incidents and ongoing issues.


CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT & AUTOMATION

 - Identify recurring issues and contribute to ticket deflection and process improvement initiatives.

 - Maintain and improve internal documentation, runbooks, and knowledge bases.

 - Contribute to small internal tooling improvements, automations, or workflow optimizations where applicable.


COMMUNITY & SIGNAL MONITORING

 - Monitor user feedback and community channels to identify early signals of potential issues or incidents.

 - Surface trends or emerging problems to internal teams proactively.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2–4 years of experience in customer support, technical support, or operations in fintech, payments, SaaS, or crypto.

 - Strong ability to understand and explain technical concepts to users with varying levels of expertise.

 - Experience troubleshooting APIs, transactions, or distributed systems is a strong plus.

 - Familiarity with payment systems, card networks (Visa, Mastercard, etc.), or crypto wallets is highly desirable.

 - Exposure to monitoring, logging, or analytics tools (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, Kibana) is a plus.

 - Basic understanding of system architecture (client → API → backend services).

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus).

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

 - Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays if required.

 - Strong ownership mindset and ability to work cross-functionally.

 - Open to a schedule that supports customers in LATAM and North America time zones.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with crypto wallets, blockchain transactions, or on-chain systems.

 - Familiarity with incident management or operational workflows.

 - Experience working with logs, dashboards, or basic debugging tools.

 - Interest in automation, scripting, or building small internal tools.

 - Familiarity with AI tools and ability to leverage them for workflow improvements, automations, or internal tooling is a plus.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Accurately diagnose and resolve user issues with minimal escalation.

 - Provide high-quality, structured escalations when needed.

 - Contribute to faster incident detection and resolution.

 - Improve user experience through clear communication and proactive support.

 - Identify trends and help reduce recurring issues over time.


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.




WHY WORK AT TRUST WALLET?

 - Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

 - Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

 - Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

 - Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

 - Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

 - Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

 - Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.



*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

jobs.title: Trade & Customs Specialist – Amsterdam (31/38 uur)
jobs.description:
Als Trade & Customs Specialist speel je een belangrijke rol in onze supply chain. Je houdt overzicht, ziet verbanden en denkt vooruit. Je bent analytisch, werkt oplossingsgericht en pakt dingen uit jezelf op. Je communiceert duidelijk en professioneel met douaneautoriteiten en collega’s uit verschillende teams. Daarnaast bouw je sterke relaties op met onze externe partners. Je toont nieuwsgierigheid en flexibiliteit, pikt nieuwe dingen snel op en deelt je kennis met collega’s. Zo help je onze processen elke dag beter en efficiënter te worden.

Ben je klaar om bij te dragen aan een future‑ready supply chain binnen de H&M Group?  Solliciteer vandaag!

WAT WORDT ER VAN JE VERWACHT?

In de rol van Trade & Customs Specialist zorg je ervoor dat onze internationale goederenstromen soepel en compliant verlopen. Je beheert documentatie, monitort zendingen, lost problemen op en ondersteunt de naleving van wet-en regelgeving in de gehele regio.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

• Toezicht houden op douaneaangiften en alle documentatie voor commerciële en niet‑commerciële goederen.
• Zorgen voor een tijdige en correcte douaneafhandeling van inkomende goederen.
• Oplossen van douane gerelateerde vragen en knelpunten.
• Relatiebeheer met douane‑expediteurs, transportpartners en serviceproviders.
• Controleren en goedkeuren van transport‑ en handelsfacturen.
• Training geven aan lokale teams over douane wet-en regelgeving, procesupdates en systeemimplementaties.
• Uitvoeren van interne audits en controles van douaneaangiften om nauwkeurigheid te waarborgen.
• Monitoren en naleven van lokale en internationale wet‑ en regelgeving.
• Voorbereiden van documentatie voor douaneautoriteiten en interne audits.
• Inzicht geven in compliance‑resultaten en verbeteringsvoorstellen doen voor processen.
• Ondersteunen van de Trade & Customs Manager en Team Lead bij operationele taken.

MET WIE WERK JE SAMEN?

Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende teams en belangrijke stakeholders binnen de organisatie om een soepele goederenstroom te garanderen.

Je belangrijkste samenwerkingspartners zijn:

• Trade & Customs Manager en Team Lead.
• Transportproviders.
• Warehouse Operations Team.
• Douane-expediteurs en externe dienstverleners.
• Finance.
• Global Trade Compliance Team.
• IT/System Support.

WIE BEN JIJ?

We zoeken iemand met:

• Een sterke kennis van douane- en internationale wet- en regelgeving, met oog voor detail.
• Een afgeronde opleiding tot (Assistent) Declarant.
• Ervaring met SAP is mooi meegenomen!
• Stevige plannings- en multitaskingvaardigheden om meerdere prioriteiten effectief te beheren.
• Commercieel inzicht om risico’s te identificeren en naleving te stimuleren.

WIE ZIJN WIJ?

H&M Group is een wereldwijd bedrijf met sterke modemerken. Ons doel is om te bewijzen dat design, betaalbare prijzen en duurzame oplossingen perfect samen kunnen gaan. Wij willen mode toegankelijk maken voor iedereen. Onze klanten staan centraal bij elke beslissing die we nemen.

We bestaan uit duizenden gepassioneerde en getalenteerde collega’s, verbonden door onze gedeelde bedrijfscultuur en waarden. Samen willen we onze kracht, vaardigheden en kennis inzetten om de mode-industrie inclusiever en duurzamer te maken.

WAT KRIJG JE ERVOOR TERUG?

Bij H&M Group zijn we trots op onze energieke en gastvrije bedrijfscultuur. We bieden aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden wereldwijd.

• Marktconform salaris.
• Personeelskorting, geldig voor alle H&M Group merken in winkels en online.
• Deelname aan het H&M Incentive Program (HIP).

JOIN US

Onze unieke kracht komt voort uit vele elementen: onze inclusieve en samenwerkende cultuur, onze sterke waarden en onze ontwikkelingskansen. Maar bovenal zijn het onze mensen die ons maken wie we zijn.

AANVULLENDE INFORMATIE

Ben je enthousiast geworden na het lezen van deze vacature? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Solliciteer direct door je CV in het Nederlands in te sturen, zo snel mogelijk maar uiterlijk voor 28 september 2026.

Daarnaast organiseren we een open avond op 30 september waarop je meer te weten kunt komen over de H&M Group, het Trade & Customs-team en de mogelijkheden binnen deze rol. Je krijgt de kans om vragen te stellen en kennis te maken met toekomstige collega's.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Управител
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

Като Управител, ръководиш стратегически магазина и екипа си, като постоянно търсиш възможности за усъвършенстване на бизнеса, с цел да подсигуриш най-доброто клиентско изживяване. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Ръководиш екипа към предоставяне на неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като гарантираш отлични оперативни и мърчандайзинг стандарти, докато с увереност представяш и продаваш нашите продукти.
• Откриваш силните страни и възможности на своя магазин, като предприемаш действия за постигане на печалба.
• Анализираш продажбите, идентифицираш възможности за подобрение, поставяш амбициозни цели и създаваш стратегии за повишаване на резултатите, печалбата и ефективното управление на наличностите.
• Организираш работния процес и графика на екипа, взимайки предвид бюджета и приоритетите на магазина.
• Избираш нови таланти, провеждаш обучения и развиваш екипа, като същевременно насърчаваш приобщаваща култура, екипна работа, професионално развитие и иновативно мислене.
• Следиш най-новите модни тенденции, предпочитанията на клиентите и динамиката на пазара, за да подсигуриш актуалност и конкурентно предимство.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.
• Промотираш активно лоялната ни програма.

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в управлението на екип в сферата на търговията.
• Умения за планиране, анализ и проследяване, използвайки различни системи и отчети.

• Доказан опит на лидерска позиция, който развива екипа си и олицетворява ценностите и културата на компанията.

И човек, който е…​

• Силен и уверен лидер, който вдъхновява, насърчава и развива своя екип.
• Мотивиран да създаде неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като с увереност препоръчва и продава нашите продукти.

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Mid Market Sales Manager at Harvey, you will lead and coach high-performing Account Executives in driving the growth and success of our AI solutions within mid sized and boutique law firms and in house legal teams. You’ll be responsible for the team’s delivery on ambitious sales targets and rolling up your sleeves to work directly with prospective Harvey customers. You’ll help refine the operational foundations of our rapidly growing Mid Market organization by developing playbooks, best practices, and a best-in-class sales toolkit. We are looking for a self-starter who can navigate ambiguity, operate in a fast-paced environment, and solve complex problems with limited oversight. Ideal candidates will have superb core sales skills, experience scaling high-velocity teams and mentoring colleagues, outstanding communication skills, and an affinity for understanding customer needs.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead a team of consultative, solution-based, Mid Market software sales professionals to achieve ARR targets through both net new logo and expansion deals.

 - Own managing and reporting on your book of business, including accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline maintenance.

 - Proactively assist with recruiting and hiring new team members.

 - Coach and develop Mid Market account executives to promote career growth

 - Refine our sales playbook to enable all sellers to better deliver consultative sales engagements at high velocity

 - Work cross-functionally across the organization to build effective sales processes and solutions that meet the needs of Harvey’s clients.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 7+ years of tech sales experience 2+ years of people management experience training and coaching a high-performance sales team.

 - Experience operating in an early stage, high-growth environment.

 - Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to a variety of audiences.

 - Proven track record of selling complex software solutions to enterprise clients, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology.

 - Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work and interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

 - Energized by mentoring account executives, contributing to the development of our sales processes and team-driven sales culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success.

jobs.title: Risk and Control Business Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Team:

The Risk & Control – Business Senior Specialist role sits within Risk & Control, part of Finance, acting as Agoda's second line of defense for risk management and providing timely assurance across business, technology, financial, and operational risk. As Agoda scales through innovation and data-driven experimentation, the team plays a critical role in balancing risk management with continued growth.

Agoda is constantly expanding its reach through strategic innovations and data-driven experimentations. As a key stakeholder and enabler of the overall Agoda business, the Agoda Risk and Control team plays a unique role in balancing risk management without stifling innovation and growth.

The Opportunity:

You'll partner across Product, IT, Supply, Commercial, People, Legal, Customer Service, and Finance — engaging at all levels to understand business processes and design controls that ensure compliance and sound risk management. As the main point of contact for business stakeholders and internal/external auditors, this role requires strong leadership and communication skills to coordinate business process risk and control activities across process owners, SOX, and audit teams. It is not a policing role: success depends on building trust as a critical partner while proactively managing risk.

The Individual:

The ideal candidate brings strong financial and business acumen, a solid grounding in internal control principles, and hands-on experience assessing risks and controls across end-to-end business processes. They are tech-savvy, with a practical understanding of how complex systems, data flows, and automation underpin business operations in a technology company. They can connect business activities to financial outcomes, assess how technology dependencies affect business process controls, and evaluate control design and operating effectiveness, including for ICFR and SOX. This is a strong fit for someone who can translate risk insights into practical improvements that support growth in a fast-growing, innovative technology company.

Key areas of responsibility (Including but Not Limited To)

• Support the Risk & Control Leadership Team in maintaining a robust Enterprise Risk Management framework that enables growth and agility.

• Maintain and continuously mature Agoda's internal control environment and full SOX compliance, including efficacy of financial reporting controls and their linkage to business processes.

• Contribute to a pragmatic control assessment, testing, and reporting framework with adequate coverage across Agoda's operations.

• Analyze and/or design IT and business process controls (SOX and non-SOX) to identify risks, control weaknesses, and gaps.

• Guide business partners in designing and implementing controls that strengthen the control environment and mitigate risk.

• Support business process control and ITAC testing and documentation, including process walkthroughs, risk and control gap identification, development of test procedures, and preparation of workpaper

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including flow charts, process narratives, and risk and control matrices.

• Act as a subject matter expert on business process risks and controls, including financial, operational, and technology-related dependencies.

• Drive timely remediation of identified control deficiencies.

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders (process owners, auditors, outsourced providers) to build relationships and coordinate assurance activities.

• Support/lead the preparation and issuance of Risk & Control reports and Risk Committee reporting packs, plus ad hoc requirements.

• Act as a brand ambassador for the Risk & Control function across Agoda

What you'll Need to Succeed:

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in Accounting or Finance; CPA, CIA, or CISA certification preferred.

• 6+ years’ experience in external audit, internal audit, internal controls, or SOX compliance with a public accounting firm or publicly listed company, with a strong focus on business processes and related controls.

• Strong understanding of the COSO internal control framework, SOX requirements, and ICFR principles, and how to apply them to assess financial, operational risks and design effective business process controls.

• Demonstrated financial and business acumen, with the adaptability to learn new processes, a practical understanding of how technology and data underpin business operations, and the ability to communicate complex risk and control issues clearly and simply.

• SOX or ICFR experience highly preferred; experience in technology, digital platforms, fintech, or online travel businesses is a plus.

• Able to work independently and collaboratively, with strong communication skills.

• Open to constructive feedback and continuous growth.

• Willing to adopt new tools, including AI, to support testing and reviews.

• Strong collaboration skills, particularly when without actual management authority

• An eye to spot control risks with an intuition of risk prioritization

• Self-starter with strong sense of responsibility, can do approach and open mindset

It's Great if you have:

• Certified Public / Chartered Accountant (CPA)/(ACA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or similar designation.

• High level of integrity is a MUST and ability to constructively challenge.

• Curious, creative and innovative, particularly in design proper controls without stiffening the business growth

• Flexibility to adapt to an ever evolving and dynamic work environment

• Quick thinker and confident in decision making

• Process, problem solving and action orientated mindset

• Good analytical skills with strong attention to detail

• Excellent communication and relationship building skills

• Professional “get it done” attitude and strong work ethic

jobs.description:
About Eon

Eon is redefining what cloud data protection can be. Founded by the team behind CloudEndure, Eon is building a new category around protecting, managing, and unlocking the value of enterprise backup data.

We work with some of the world’s largest companies to make their cloud backup and recovery data more accessible, searchable, secure, and AI-ready. With $500M raised from leading investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Greenoaks, BOND, and Elad Gil, Eon is at an exciting stage of rapid growth.

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can understand highly technical products, identify what truly differentiates them, and turn that into compelling positioning, messaging, and go-to-market programs.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership across positioning, product launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and GTM execution. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and the broader Marketing team.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Eon’s products, from product launches and campaigns to messaging, positioning, and sales enablement.

• Own product positioning and messaging, translating complex concepts across cloud infrastructure, backup and recovery, data protection, resilience, and AI-ready data into clear customer value.

• Develop a deep understanding of Eon’s products, customers, and technical differentiation and turn that knowledge into compelling stories for different audiences.

• Conduct customer and market research to understand customer needs, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies, and industry trends.

• Build and maintain competitive intelligence and positioning against both established vendors and emerging companies across data protection, cloud infrastructure, and adjacent markets.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to understand the roadmap, influence launch strategy, and ensure our messaging accurately reflects the product and its differentiation.

• Work closely with Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success to create sales enablement materials, competitive guidance, training, presentations, demos, and other customer-facing assets.

• Create and develop product marketing content across websites, campaigns, blogs, reports, videos, presentations, and other channels, working with internal teams and external creative partners where needed.

• Partner with the broader Marketing team on campaigns and integrated GTM initiatives that drive awareness, pipeline, and customer engagement.

• Monitor product and campaign performance and use data, customer feedback, and market signals to continuously improve positioning, messaging, and GTM execution.

• Use AI-native tools as part of your day-to-day workflow for research, competitive intelligence, content development, analysis, experimentation, and productivity.

What We’re Looking For

• 4+ years of relevant B2B product marketing experience, ideally in cloud infrastructure, data protection, backup and recovery, cybersecurity, or AI infrastructure.

• Strong technical foundation, with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

• Ability to quickly understand complex technical products and translate them into simple, differentiated, and compelling customer-facing stories.

• Proven experience taking technical B2B products to market, including positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, and sales enablement.

• Strong ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Marketing.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts without losing technical depth or credibility.

• Strong understanding of market research, competitive analysis, customer segmentation, and positioning.

• Hands-on experience using modern AI tools in day-to-day marketing workflows, with genuine curiosity about how AI is changing the way products are built and marketed.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities evolve and you’re expected to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.

• Data-driven and comfortable using performance metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.

• Strong bias toward action, with the ability to move from strategy to execution quickly.

The annual base salary range is $155,000 - $190,000. Actual salaries will vary and are based on a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies. Salary is just one component of our Compensation Philosophy. Variable/Bonus Compensation & Equity Incentives align with individual and company performance."

WAT JE GAAT DOEN

Als Department Manager geef je leiding aan je team en ondersteun je hen, terwijl je een inclusieve cultuur stimuleert waarin samenwerking en ondernemerschap centraal staan. Je zorgt voor een uitstekende operationele én visuele winkelbeleving – zowel voor klanten als collega’s.

Jij:

• zorgt voor een sterke visuele en commerciële presentatie om onze klanten een geweldige winkelervaring te bieden met behulp van servicetools.
• analyseert verkoop- en budgetdoelen en ontwikkelt optimalisatiemaatregelen.
• plant taken en personeelsinzet efficiënt in en zorgt ervoor dat alle operationele processen soepel verlopen – van de winkelvloer en het magazijn tot aan de kassa’s, paskamerroutines en de dagelijkse winkelopening en -sluiting.
• ontwikkelt je team op strategische wijze door middel van gerichte werving, onboarding, regelmatige feedbackgesprekken, prestatie-evaluaties en individuele ontwikkelplannen.

Wil je meer weten over de rol van Department Manager? Luister naar onze Jobcast-aflevering en kom meer tew eten over de functie uit eerste hand – rechtstreeks van ons team: Department Manager

Zodra je op de link klikt, verlaat je onze site en word je doorgestuurd naar Spotify. Je vindt het privacybeleid van Spotify AB hier: Privacybeleid - Spotify.

MET WIE JE GAAT SAMENWERKEN

Onze winkels vormen het hart van H&M – daar waar klanten het merk van dichtbij beleven. Elk teamlid draagt bij aan een inspirerende en gastvrije sfeer. Je werkt nauw samen met je team om onze klanten te helpen zich zelfverzekerd te voelen en zichzelf te uiten met de nieuwste trends en tijdloze stijlen.

WIE JIJ BENT

Wij zoeken talenten met...

• Leiderschapsvaardigheden en ervaring in retail
• Motivatie en empathie om je team te inspireren en zo een geweldige winkelervaring te creëren
• Een duidelijke focus op planning en prioriteiten om de winkel efficiënt te laten draaien.

En talenten die...

• oplossingsgericht, flexibel en analytisch denken
• teamgericht werken, duidelijk communiceren en actief luisteren
• een passie hebben voor mode, trends en commercie

WIE WIJ ZIJN

De H&M Group is een wereldwijd bedrijf met sterke modemerken en innovatieve businesslijnen. Wij geloven dat excellent design, betaalbare prijzen en duurzame oplossingen hand in hand kunnen gaan. Onze klanten staan centraal in alles wat we doen. Onze bedrijfscultuur wordt gevormd door duizenden gepassioneerde en getalenteerde teamleden. Samen gebruiken we onze schaal en kennis om de mode-industrie te leiden richting een inclusievere en duurzamere toekomst.

WAAROM JE HIER GRAAG WILT WERKEN

We zijn trots op ons levendige en open karakter. Onze teams profiteren van aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en diverse ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden wereldwijd.

• Personeelskorting op al onze producten en merken
• 25 vakantiedagen
• HIP – H&M Incentive Program (bonusprogramma)
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) voor een gezonde werk-privébalans
• Corporate Benefits (exclusieve kortingen bij veel merken)
• Bedrijfspensioenregeling
• Reiskostenvergoeding
• Contract van 1 jaar met uitzicht op verlenging
• Brutosalaris afhankelijk van ervaring vanaf:38 uur: €2.710,47

KOM ERBIJ

Onze kracht en uniciteit zitten in veel dingen – in onze inclusieve cultuur, onze sterke waarden en onze ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Maar bovenal zijn het onze teams die ons maken tot wat we zijn.

*Meer informatie over de verwerking van jouw persoonlijke gegevens vind je in onze mededeling over gegevensbescherming.

** We streven naar een eerlijk en gelijk proces en vragen je geen sollicitatiebrief mee te sturen, omdat deze vaak informatie bevat die gemakkelijk kan leiden tot onbedoelde vooroordelen.

*** Om het grote aantal sollicitaties voor functies met leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheden te beheren, gebruiken we een online beoordelingsmethode. Je moet deze voltooien als onderdeel van het sollicitatie- en screeningsproces. Je antwoorden worden gescoord door een beoordelingstool die vooraf gedefinieerde criteria toepast die door H&M Group zijn vastgesteld.

jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik Kcentar Sub City
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE!

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

Nakon dovršetka procjene imat ćeš priliku podijeliti povratne informacije i postaviti pitanja. Ako naiđeš na bilo kakve poteškoće ili preferiraš alternativnu metodu procjene, obrati se na recruitment_support@hm.com. Odabir alternativne metode neće utjecati na tvoju prijavu.

Više informacija o tome kako obrađujemo tvoje osobne podatke, pronađi u našoj Politici privatnosti.

** Predani smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, pravedan i temelji se na kompetencijama. Stoga te molimo da svojoj prijavi ne prilažeš motivacijsko pismo.​

jobs.title: Diet Rep-Marianjoy, Part Time, Rotating Shifts
jobs.description:
Part-Time Diet Rep (Benefits Eligible)

Join our nutrition services team in a fast-paced healthcare environment at Marianjoy Rehab Hospital!

This part-time position requires availability every other weekend, every other Monday, every Friday, and rotating holidays.

• Mondays and Fridays 6:00 am-2:30 pm
• Saturday and Sunday 10:00 am-6:30 pm

We're looking for a candidate with excellent customer service skills, strong computer proficiency, and the ability to stay organized while multitasking. Previous food service experience is preferred, especially in a healthcare setting, but is not required.

The Rep Diet Office reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsible for answering the telephone, processing communications regarding diet orders and maintaining the diet office system with current, correct information.

Responsibilities:

• Processes diet orders, discharges, transfers, admits, nutrition notes, menus and patient preferences correctly.
• Assures BHS and 1N menus are correct and all patients have a meal ordered.
• Fills out, enters and prints all paperwork in a timely, organized and complete manner - nourishment labels, Patient List with Notes, Unables, Missed Meals Report, menu entry menus and supplement and floorstock charges.
• Demonstrates an ability to be flexible, organized and function under stressful situations.

Required:

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent
• Basic computer knowledge
• Food Handler Certification within 180 days of hire

Preferred:

• Six months experience

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information

NorthwesternMedicine Career Page

https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE.

Reality Defender is an award-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time.

Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI-generated media is not used for malicious purposes.

Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TKOZmwyNUNM




THE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE ROLE.

We are seeking a highly experienced Account Executive to drive strategic sales across regulated industries and organizations with significant compliance, fraud prevention, and security requirements. This individual will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, helping customers address emerging risks related to deepfake impersonation, identity fraud, and AI-enabled social engineering.

This role requires a consultative seller with strong experience navigating complex buying processes, engaging senior stakeholders, and delivering cybersecurity or enterprise technology solutions that address mission-critical security and compliance challenges. Responsibilities include:

 - Own and drive the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting through contract execution, deployment, and expansion

 - Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities within financial services, government, insurance, and other regulated or high-compliance industries

 - Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, including CISOs, fraud leaders, risk and compliance teams, and executive decision-makers

 - Lead complex sales processes involving technical validation, security and compliance reviews, procurement, and legal negotiations

 - Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to deliver effective customer engagements and successful implementations




WHO YOU ARE.

 - 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling cybersecurity, SaaS, AI, or enterprise technology solutions

 - Proven track record of closing complex, high-value enterprise deals with organizations operating in regulated or high-compliance environments

 - Experience selling to senior security, risk, fraud, or IT stakeholders

 - Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex technical solutions to both technical and business audiences

 - Consistent history of meeting or exceeding revenue targets




WHAT WE OFFER.

Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location:

 - Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents

 - Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents

 - Short/Long-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees

 - FSA/HSA and 401k programs

 - Equity compensation

 - 20 days of PTO per year

 - 12 weeks of Parental Leave

 - Learning and Development budget

 - Monthly wellness benefits

 - Annual company-sponsored offsite

For employees working from Reality Defender’s HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits:

 - Daily in-office lunch through UberEats

 - Commuter benefits

 - Remote Fridays

 - Happy Hours and other local events

jobs.title: Automation Operator
jobs.description:
Every day at Disney Cruise Line we take pride in bringing the magic of Disney to life. We find joy in creating cherished memories and form genuine connections with our guests. We hold each other to the highest degree and always act responsibly while ensuring the safety of fellow crew and guests. United by our Disney values, we work toward excellence in all we do. As a part of our team, you can live and work in a diverse and inclusive environment amidst a professional and supportive community. If you are ready to create unforgettable experiences and grow as a person and as a professional, apply today.

As an Automation Operator, you will manage the operation of Entertainment Automation Systems at the Walt Disney Theater including the movement of stage scenic elements during our Broadway/West End Style Musical Theater Production Shows. You will also maintain all ship wide automation and rigging systems to ensure good repair and proper usage for outdoor deck parties, shows and events.

You will report to Senior Technician WDT

Level: Officer

Responsibilities :

• Manage the operation of Entertainment Automation Systems at the Walt Disney Theater including all stage scenic elements during shows
• Oversee the maintenance and safe operation of all rigging equipment used in outdoor shows and events
• Train in all outdoor rigging positions to safely operate during shows
• Be an important contributor to the WDT Theater Team with responsibilities for load in and load outs, Cast changeovers, new show installations, equipment tests, vendor support, movie premiers and company events

Basic Qualifications :

• Minimum five years show production experience in a similar role
• Experience operating computerized automation control equipment
• Experience or qualifications in a theatrical/ Entertainment-based rigging operation
• Proficiency with hydraulics, electronics, electric motors, motor drives and controls, manual and automated rigging devices
• Can work at heights and with heavy equipment

Additional Information :

This is a SHIPBORAD role

Benefits offered year-round, on contract and off-contract, as long as return contract is signed, including Major Medical Coverage, Short & Long Term Disability, Life Insurance and Retirement Savings Plan Option
You must:

• Be genuinely interested in a career at sea and willing to live and work onboard a Disney Cruise Line vessel
• Be willing to follow and perform safety role, emergency responsibilities and associated responsibilities as specified in the ship Assembly Plan
• Be willing to uphold the general safety management responsibilities as specified in the Safety Management System in areas and operations under their control
• If applicable, be willing to share a confined cabin with other crew members and appreciative of working and living in a multicultural environment that has strict rules and regulations

Your Responsibilities:

• Have a valid passport and C1/D Seaman's visa (DCL will provide you with documents to obtain this)
• Complete a pre-employment medical
• Obtain a criminal background check
• Bring approved work shoes

**Disney Cruise Line is a drug-free workplace. All new hires are required to undergo drug/alcohol testing within the first week onboard and throughout their contracts. Failure to pass the drug/alcohol testing will result in immediate termination.

#DCLPJ

jobs.title: Public Relations Manager
jobs.location: New York City (NYC), New York, United States
jobs.description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company and a proud Great Place to Work® Certified employer in the US!

As a PR Manager on the Marketing team in our New York City office, you’ll play a vital role in building and amplifying our external message, building and owning a pipeline of news, articulating our message in clear ways, earning accolades, supporting executive speaking engagements and more. You’ll be a strategic bridge between our technology and compelling media narratives that drive brand authority and trust. Ultimately, you’ll own an ‘always on’ PR program for our U.S. market.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:

• 4+ years of experience in public relations, ideally with a mix of in-house and agency experience.

• Knowledge of adtech basics and the media landscape that covers it.

• Strong writing acumen and ability to translate complex topics into simple to understand language for advertisers, publishers, partners, and reporters.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally and globally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Excellent project management and organization skills with an eye for detail.

• Data-driven mindset, ability to produce results and show tangible metrics.

Bonus points if you have:

• Existing connections within adtech or business publications that are relevant to our business.

• Familiarity with newer, influencer-driven outlets like podcasts and substacks within the adtech industry.

• Knowledge of how generative AI tools can aid in PR processes.

How you’ll make an impact:

• Collaborate internally with product marketing, account managers, and sellers, you will identify and introduce impactful stories to the market. This includes product launches, client wins, and leveraging internal data for trade and mainstream publications.

• Coordinate and facilitate executive press interviews.

• Create key PR assets like press releases, pitches, media briefings, coverage reports and analyses, with language that resonates for our audiences.

• Become an expert on our offerings and data, constantly thinking of new ways to tell stories that drive PR results.

• Support global launches, collaborating with regional teams to source relevant context to inform US PR narrative.

• Partner with social media, content and creative teams to amplify earned coverage across channels.

• Submit for industry awards and speaking opportunities, keeping updated on new opportunities, working with internal teams to source information and earn opportunities.

• Maintain and update media lists, coverage trackers, press room and reporting dashboards.

Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

• Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.

• Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401k matching), pre-tax commuter benefits, and a fully stocked kitchen.

• Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.

• Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

#LI-RT1

#LI-Hybrid

The pay offered may vary depending on several factors such as location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We may offer several perks as part of the compensation package that include a discretionary bonus, equity, flexible PTO, medical/dental/vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) match, paid parental leave, and more.

Base Salary Pay Range

$100,000—$116,000 USD

jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.description:
Primary function is the prevention of anything that is likely to cause loss, waste, damage or inconvenience to the client or its customers.

Expectations of this position are to:

• Fully and satisfactorily complete all of the training that has been agreed is necessary for the particular site.
• Fully and satisfactorily complete all of the tasks and duties on site as defined within the published Assignment Instructions (AI’s).
• Proactively refer to and review the published Assignment Instructions, thus familiarising oneself with any changes and in order to suggest changes that can proactively improve or enhance the level of service.
• Where required, monitor CCTV system.
• Look out for, and to immediately report, any Health & Safety hazards, or potential hazards, on client location.
• Stay alert to any threats or changes within the work environment in order to take the appropriate action in order to reduce the chance of disruption, loss or damage.
• Use common sense and initiative by immediately involving others if a situation appears to become threatening.
• Complete an accurate, detailed notebook entry as soon as possible after any incident, which can then be used as part of the Incident Report process Details.

• Employer Contribution Pension Scheme from the day you join the Company

jobs.title: Senior People Partner - GTM
jobs.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.



Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.



Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.



A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.



🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.



 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.



🤝  We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.



💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.



Orbital is building the AI technology powering the future of enterprise legal work. We're growing fast, and we need a Senior People Partner who wants to help us get this right from the ground up.



This isn't a maintain-the-machine role. You'll be the first People hire in the US, partnering with our GTM leadership while also owning the design and build of people solutions that actually scale. Strategy and execution. Influence and craft. Both, in the same role.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You'll sit across two layers of how our People function operates: Partner and Product.

 - As a Partner, you'll work closely with our go-to-market managers, coaching them through performance, team health, and people challenges, and building the kind of trusted relationships that give you real signal on what needs fixing.

 - As a Product builder, you'll take those insights and turn them into scalable solutions: frameworks, enablement tools, programs, and processes that don't just solve the immediate problem but grow with the business.

Your early focus will include manager capability, performance enablement, and building out the US-specific foundations of our People stack, including compliance, leave administration, and multi-state employment. But you'll help shape the roadmap, not just inherit one.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU

 - Have strong People Partnering experience, ideally supporting GTM, Sales or Commercial teams

 - Know US employment law well: FLSA, FMLA, Title VII, ADA, multi-state compliance, at-will

 - Think like a product manager: you diagnose before you design, and you measure what you ship

 - Are energised by ambiguity and building from scratch, not navigating existing bureaucracy

 - Bring both the strategic thinking and the hands-on drive to see things through

 - Are curious about AI and technology and actively look for ways to work smarter

 - Experience in high-growth tech or legaltech; OTE and variable comp exposure; any UK employment law familiarity.




WHAT WE'RE OFFERING

 - $165,000-$185,000 base salary depending on experience, plus equity, 401k match, and comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage.

 - Hybrid role: 2 days in our New York office. Generous PTO, parental leave, commuter benefits, and a personal development budget.

 - You'll be joining at the moment it matters, early enough to shape how the US function is built, with the backing of an experienced London-based team behind you.




THE PROCESS

 1. Screening call (60 min)

 2. Hiring Manager call (60 min)

 3. Take-home task

 4. Panel discussion and Culture conversation (90 min)

 5. Offer

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.



💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.



💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.



Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.
